title.en: War of the Corsets – Fighting to Shape Femininity at the Turn of the Last Century

events.description: The corset is one of the most controversial garments in the history of fashion. It has been worn for centuries, shaping women's bodies according to the ideals of different times. It came into particular focus at the end of the 19th century. A lively debate flared up in Sweden, which came to be known as the corset war.

title.en: Stadsvandring med Christopher O'Regan - Grändernas hemligheter

ai.en: A city walk in Gamla stan led by Christopher O'Regan, exploring the secrets of the city's old quarters through stories from Swedish history.

events.description: Du har kanske sett honom på TV, där han trollbinder sina tittare med berättelser om Sveriges historia. Med sina gedigna kunskaper och sin eleganta vältalighet levandegör Christopher som ingen annan det förflutna. Nu har Du möjligheten att få uppleva honom livs levande och följa med på en av hans underhållande stadsvandringar i Stockholm. Han har ett kvarts sekels erfarenhet på området, och under hans kunniga och charmerande vägledning får du möta människorna som en gång befolkade de skuggiga kvarteren i Gamla stan. Samlingsplats är på Slottsbacken, vid obelisken. Se på karta: Samlingsplats Barn 0-14 år är välkomna att följa med kostnadsfritt utan biljett. Möt 1700-talets Stockholm på Christopher O'Regans Youtubekanal

ai.en: Mamma Mia! The Party, an interactive ABBA-themed night with food, drinks and entertainment.

events.description: Mamma Mia! The Party is an interactive experience where guests enjoy food, drinks, and entertainment inspired by ABBA's music. The event takes place at Tyrol, a festive venue with a magical atmosphere. The experience combines theater, music, and dance in a unique setting that invites community and celebration.

ai.en: Torka aldrig tårar utan handskar, a newly written musical at Göta Lejon based on Jonas Gardell's novel and TV series.

events.description: TORKA ALDRIG TÅRAR UTAN HANDSKAR -- EN HELT NYSKRIVEN MUSIKAL Jonas Gardells roman och tv-serie Torka aldrig tårar utan handskar fullkomligt välte Sverige hösten 2012. Ett helt svenskt folk förälskade sig i Rasmus och Benjamin och deras vänner med den legendariska fjollan Paul i spetsen. För första gången i Sverige presenteras nu en scenversion, i form av en helt nyskriven musikal av Fredrik Kempe och Jonas Gardell! Premiär på Göta Lejon i Stockholm den 24 september 2026. Regisserar gör Carl Johan Karlson, som gjorde kultföreställningen Arv på Dramaten. I huvudrollerna ser vi Ola Salo som Paul och som Rasmus och Benjamin ser vi Valdemar Wahlbeck och Martin Stokke Mathiesen. Med orkester under ledning av Karl-Johan Ankarblom och stor ensemble, för att inte tala om en fullkomligt slösande påkostad scenografi av Magdalena Åberg, blir detta 2026 års Stora Scen-händelse i Stockholm! Jonas Gardell och Fredrik Kempe har tidigare skrivit musikalen Livet är en schlager, en jättesuccé med 200 000 besökare, och Fredrik Kempe har sedan dess haft stora framgångar med musikalerna Såsom i Himmelen och Änglagård. Nu återförenas de alltså i en musikal som de arbetat med tillsammans sedan 2019 Torka aldrig tårar utan handskar blev av DN:s läsare vald till en av de tre viktigaste kulturhändelserna i Sverige på 150 år! Den gjorde Jonas Gardell till Årets Svensk, tv-serien har utsetts till "Bästa svenska TV-serie genom tiderna" och böckerna har sålt i 100 000-tals exemplar. Rekommenderas från 13…

ai.en: ccap's GAME ON, a new contemporary dance work by Cristina Capriolis for Stora Scen in Stockholm.

events.description: GAME ON En ansats avstår sitt framsteg i Cristina Capriolis nya arbete för Stora scen. En ansats avstår sitt framsteg för att i stället ägna sig åt en strängt hållen inåtrörelse vars oundvikliga utfall är en utspridande turbulens som öppnar rummet för en motström som inte räds sitt tidskrävande horisontala glid som vid sin yttersta kant vänder till ett vibrerande som måste bli en fonetisk ståendevåg vars nedåtriktade svalgkakofoni i sin saknad av ansvar och förlitlighet säkrar en väl sammansatt dans inte längre dans mycket mer och djupare in i sin dans. I detta rum. Nu och inte senare. Längd: ca 60 min. Före och efter föreställningen fortgår "spelet" i Blackbox. Mer info om detta i höst.

ai.en: Svartklubben, a dinner-and-music experience in the dark, where guests eat and enjoy performances without sight.

events.description: På den legala Svartklubben får du njuta av läcker mat, specialkomponerad musik och fantastiska sinnesupplevelser. Här får du rika möjligheter att utforska mat, dryck och underhållning på ett nytt sätt! Hur fungerar det att kommunicera utan syn för dig och din grupp? Fascineras av synskadade sjungande servitörer. Utmana dig själv och ät en unik måltid! Det här är garanterat en stark upplevelse med många nya dimensioner. Skrämmande? Ingen fara. Det här mörkret är varmt och välkomnande! Menyn hålls hemlig för att förhöja upplevelsen! - Trerätters. I priset ingår mörkerupplevelsen, underhållning och en trerättersmeny. - Trerätters Deluxe. I priset ingår mörkerupplevelsen, underhållning, en trerättersmeny med välkomstdrink samt två glas vin/öl, kaffe & dessertvin. - Dryck beställs på plats. OBS! - Om du eller någon i ditt sällskap behöver specialkost kan ni boka det via vår hemsida www.svartklubben.com/specialkost. Detta måste göras senast 24 timmar innan eventet. Tider: Insläppstid: 18:00 Spellängd: 3 tim 30 min Mer info: www.svartklubben.com

ai.en: Bengt Forsberg plays piano transcriptions of Bach by Rachmaninov, Busoni, Godowsky and Grainger at Allhelgonakyrkan. Free entry for visitors under 26.

events.description: Bengt Forsberg framför Bachtranskriptioner för piano av Rachmaninov, Busoni, Godowsky, Grainger m fl. Gratis entré för besökare under 26 år. Finns platser kvar på konsertdagen säljs de för samma pris vid entrén från kl 17.15. Vi kan ta emot betalning med kreditkort, Swish och kontanter. Platserna är onumrerade, insläpp kl 17.30.

ai.en: IDOL LIVE 2026 at Filadelfia Convention Center in Stockholm, a live talent show where Sweden's next singing star is chosen on stage.

events.description: UPPLEV IDOL LIVE! Välkommen till en oförglömlig kväll där drömmar kan bli verklighet och stjärnor föds! På Idol Live får du uppleva den magiska stämningen på nära håll när Sveriges nästa stjärna kliver upp på scen. En kväll fylld av musik och storslagna ögonblick! Var med och heja fram din idol hela vägen fram till vinsten. Träffa Pär Lärnström, Idoljuryn och kanske en och annan gästartist. Missa inte chansen att uppleva Idol Live! Sjung med och känn pulsen Åldersgräns 13 år (7 år i Målsmans sällskap)

ai.en: Ringmasters celebrate 20 years on Saturday 24 October at 20:00 in Berns' large hall, with doors at 19:00.

events.description: Insläppstid: 19:00 Starttid: 20:00 I år är ett speciellt år för oss i Ringmasters då vi hunnit nå 20 år tillsammans som grupp. Av denna anledning bjuder vi in till en alldeles extra speciell kväll lördag 24 oktober klockan 20.00 i Berns stora sal! Det kommer bli en hejdundrande fest där vi bjuder på underhållning i klassiskt Ringmasters-manér och såklart med lite överraskningar. Denna kväll vill vi fira med er, våra vänner, fans och följare. Varmt välkomna! Lite praktiskt: Det kommer vara en festkväll med underhållning och inte en traditionell konsert. Vi uppträder flera gånger under kvällen och ni får utrymme att mingla, dansa och handla i baren. Det kommer finnas begränsat med stolar för de som behöver. Åldersgräns: 18 år
Dörrar 19.00 Show 20.00 Åldersgräns 18 år Arrangör: Live Nation Rullstolsplatser köps via Ticketmasters tillgänglighetslinje tel; 0776-70 77 77 En ledsagare går med gratis på samma biljett

ai.en: EUROPE at B-K in Stockholm, with The Damn Truth as support. Ages 18 and over. Doors at 19:00 and show at 20:00, presented by Live Nation.

events.description: Support: The Damn Truth Åldersgräns 18+ Dörrar: 19:00 Show: 20:00 Arrangör: Live Nation

The Postal Museum's new exhibition Swedish stamps reflects the country we live in. In recent years alone, you'll find epatraktors, the king, peace symbols, suffrage fighters and many more motifs. Small pictures of Sweden that we then put on our letters, invitations, Christmas cards or small gifts we send to each other. But how are the motifs actually selected? What makes up the picture and how is a stamp designed? You'll find out in the exhibition A Little Corner of Sweden.

ai.en: A cocktail course and workshop at Bartenderlab in central Stockholm, learning classic and modern cocktails.

events.description: Join an entertaining cocktail course and workshop in central Stockholm! Learn to mix classic and modern cocktails with professional guidance. The course includes 2-3 glasses of sparkling wine and 2-3 cocktails. Perfect for beginners and cocktail enthusiasts alike. Pricing and reservation in the link.

ai.en: The Ulriksdal Autumn Market at Ulriksdal Castle grounds over three days in October, with crafts and food.

events.description: During three days in October, Ulriksdal's beautiful Palace Park will be filled with exquisite crafts and delicious delicacies. Take a walk in the Palace park and visit Ulriksdal Palace.

ai.en: James Cameron – Challenging the Deep at the Vasa Museum, on the filmmaker's ocean exploration and technology.

events.description: This temporary exhibition at the Vasa Museum highlights filmmaker, ocean explorer, and technology innovator James Cameron, combining props from his feature films with film projections and rare objects. Visitors can experience Cameron’s greatest underwater endeavors, both real and fictional. The exhibition is produced by the Australian National Maritime Museum in collaboration with the Avatar Alliance Foundation.

title.en: Top Secret Ursvik; City walk/Spy walk...

ai.en: The Top Secret Ursvik spy walk, a city walking tour of Stockholm's secretive history.

events.description: Welcome to Sweden's most secretive walking tour! The oldest and still unbeatably popular tour takes you right into the heart of the former top secret military area of Ursvik, Sundbyberg -- a place so secret it was scrubbed from most maps. What was hidden inside the bunker and the masked storehouses? What did the “Russians” know? And why was there talk in whispers about Swedish nuclear weapons, nuclear submarines and... radioactive pigs? PLUS! See genuine spy items -- straight from history!

events.venue: The parking lot to the left of the "Milot" Preschool

title.en: Full-Day Guided Fishing Tour with a fishing guide

events.description: Spend a full day fishing in the Stockholm Archipelago. This guided tour starts in Vaxholm and takes you by boat among islands, bays and rocky shores. We target pike, perch and, in colder seasons, sea trout with modern sport fishing gear adapted to season and weather. All experience levels are welcome but no experience needed, your guide is there for you. All equipment plus food and beverages included. Perfect for friends, families, couples or solo travellers wanting a memorable day.

title.en: Jesus Christ Superstar at Kulturhuset Stadsteatern

ai.en: Jesus Christ Superstar at Kulturhuset Stadsteatern, Andrew Lloyd Webber and Tim Rice's rock musical about Jesus's last days.

events.description: In Andrew Lloyd Webber and Tim Rice's beloved rock musical, we follow Jesus' last days of life. How his grassroots movement shakes the grip of power over the people. Where the road to crucifixion is shaped by the struggle between light and darkness. A drama marked by faith, doubt, and power. The cast includes Alexander Lycke, Fredrik Lycke, and Marsha Songcome. Directed by Maria Sid. Premiere October 9.

Bring children and grandchildren and become part of the postal adventure. You sort packages at the terminal, distribute letters in mailboxes and deliver packages. Craft a personal greeting and send it by post. At Postis, every child becomes a real postal hero.

Express your creativity by painting pre-made pottery pieces from a wide range of designs. Whether it’s a fun kids’ activity, a special celebration, or some well-deserved me time, our 2-hour pottery painting sessions are perfect for all ages and skill levels.

title.en: Guided Hike in Stockholm Nature Reserve + Campfire Lunch

events.description: Take a break from the hustle and bustle of Stockholm and immerse yourself in the serene surroundings of the Nacka Nature Reserve. Just a quick 20-minute drive from the city, this beautiful reserve is the perfect place to spend a day in nature. Enjoy a leisurely walk through the dense forests and over the high granite cliffs, taking in the views and fresh air. You will also be treated to a campfire-cooked lunch, adding an authentic touch to your experience.

title.en: Ghost Theatre in Stockholm’s Old Town

ai.en: A ghost-themed walking theatre tour through the alleys and squares of Stockholm's Old Town, with stories of the city's darker past.

events.description: Join a spooky theatrical walk through the dark alleys and squares of Stockholm’s Old Town. Meet historical characters such as executioner Jürgen Homuth and royal assassin Anckarström, while discovering stories from Stockholm’s darker past. An atmospheric experience for history lovers, groups and families with children over 10.

ai.en: AVSKALAT, a wine and cider festival at Brygghuset focused on organic and biodynamic wines and craft cider.

events.description: AVSKALAT is a festival focusing on organic & biodynamic wines and handcrafted cider. On site, some of Sweden's leading importers and producers present honest drinks with a unique range of products to try. In addition, suitable food and delicacies are also offered to eat on site. A warm welcome!

ai.en: Pottery painting at Måla Keramiks studios in central Stockholm, a new concept where you paint your own ceramics.

events.description: Pottery painting as it should be - MålaKeramik.se is a brand new concept with several studios in central Stockholm. Our ambition is to offer as many people as possible the chance to paint pottery in Stockholm in some of the capital's most beautiful environments. With a wide range items from cups and plates to vases and decorations, you can paint your own unique pottery and ceramics. Welcome to enjoy some analog quality time with us!

ai.en: A Halloween celebration at Skansen, where ghosts, goblins and creatures come to life in the open-air museum.

events.description: This autumn, outdoor museum Skansen transforms into a place of spooky magic as ghosts, goblins, and mysterious creatures come to life after dark. Among the glowing lanterns, rustling leaves, and historic houses, you and your family are invited to step into a world where chills meet charm.

title.en: Humanity’s Last Breath + Support: Vildhjarta + Enterprise Earth + Karmanjakah

ai.en: Humanity's Last Breath with support from Vildhjarta and Enterprise Earth at Kollektivet Livet, an extreme metal show.

events.description: Humanity’s Last Breath hör till de mest kompromisslösa namnen inom modern extremmetal. Med albumet Ashen och senaste singeln ”Godhood” har de fortsatt att tänja gränserna för genren med ett rått, tekniskt och skoningslöst uttryck. Tillsammans med Vildhjarta, Enterprise Earth och Karmanjakah väntar en kväll där precision, tyngd och intensitet står i centrum.

ai.en: Jewish Värmland at the Jewish Museum, on what remains of Jewish life when a synagogue has been demolished.

events.description: What remains of a Jewish life when the synagogue has been demolished and traces in the city have almost disappeared? "Jewish Värmland" explores Jewish life in Karlstad and Värmland from the 19th century to today through photographs, archival material, objects, and personal testimonies. Produced with Värmlands Museum and previously presented in Karlstad, the exhibition is now shown in a new version in Stockholm.

ai.en: From piggy banks to Swish, an interactive exhibition at Tumba bruksmuseum where children and adults talk about money and how it has changed.

events.description: Welcome to an imaginative environment where children and adults can share thoughts about money. In the exhibition, you can discover how views on children and money have changed over the course of a hundred years. Please note that all exhibition signage is in Swedish.

ai.en: Lotta Antonsson's I Am Everything exhibition at Fotografiska, exploring gender, identity and objectification in photography.

events.description: One of Sweden’s leading contemporary photographers, Lotta Antonsson, is coming to Fotografiska with I Am Everything. In this exhibition, the artist explores themes of gender, identity, and objectification within a visual world that both unsettles and beautifies. The exhibition moves fluidly between photography, collage, and spatial installations.

title.en: Alfred Nobel - Mr. Dynamite - the musical

ai.en: Mr. Dynamite, a musical at Ö2 Scenkonst Södermalm about Alfred Nobel and the story behind the Nobel Prize.

events.description: Mr. Dynamite - presents the man behind the Nobel Prize, the multifaceted Alfred Nobel, whose final wish was nearly thwarted when family, authorities and even King Oscar II opposed the Nobel Prize - a prize that still profoundly influences the world today. The true story of Mr. Dynamite is set to unfold in an exciting, entertaining and musical production, premiering on October 7 at Ö2 Scenkonst Södermalm.

ai.en: A clown and Le Jeu theatre workshop, exploring the grammar of theatre through games, improvisation and humour.

events.description: Theatre workshop to discover the grammar of theatre: Games, complicite, impulse, acting pleasure, humour, fixed point, lightness, beauty. Second part of the workshop is clown. We will through improvisations discover what is funny about ourselves in order to make audience laughing at this wonderfully open and naive red nosed person who appears on the stage when we least expect it.

ai.en: Blowing Figures into Space by Davide Rivalta, a large outdoor sculpture show of twelve animal figures in Kungliga Nationalstadsparken.

events.description: Blowing Figures into Space by the sculptor Davide Rivalta is a large-scale outdoor exhibition. It comprises twelve animal sculptures in bronze and aluminum, installed in symbolic locations, creating new perspectives on nature, power and coexistence. The sculptures are placed directly on the ground making them appear as if they have reclaimed the urban environment. Through this approach, Rivalta makes art accessible in public spaces and promotes dialogue across cultures. Guided tours each month.

ai.en: Bondens Own autumn farmers' market in Södermalm, selling local vegetables, berries, meat, game, salmon and crayfish.

events.description: Bondens Own Autumn Markets offer direct sales of locally produced goods such as vegetables, berries, meat, game, salmon, crayfish, flour, honey, bread, eggs, cheese, and flowers. The market is run by members of the Riksföreningen Bondens egen Marknad association, where all products come from farms within a 250 km radius.

ai.en: Embraced, an exhibition at Kulturhuset Stadsteatern where visitors become part of the art through sculpture, textile and painting.

events.description: “Embraced” is an exhibition where the viewer not only looks at art, but becomes part of it. Through sculpture, textile, painting, sound, and spatial installations, the body, senses, and presence are activated. Welcome to an immersive art experience featuring contemporary works by Frida Fjellman, Yasmina Karli Malmsten, Sanne Lovén Rolén, and Anna Nyberg.

Residue explores how materials move through geological, industrial and technological systems, continually transforming in form, function and value. During the Open Studio at Färgfabriken, seven artists from Korvfabriken will use the space as a shared working environment, continuing the research through material experiments, conversations, tests and artistic processes.

ai.en: Young Opera: Lost, a whimsical dream play with music by Andrea Tarrodi at the Royal Swedish Opera, reminiscent of Alice's Adventures in Wonderland.

events.description: "The opera is simply a little gem – lucky are those who manage to secure a ticket!” wrote Dagens Nyheter after the 2024 premiere. Now, Lost (Vilse) is finally back! Lost is a whimsical dream play that is reminiscent of Alice’s Adventures in Wonderland, with music by Andrea Tarrodi – one of our most acclaimed contemporary Swedish composers. Its 2024 première proved popular with critics and audiences of all ages. This is a truly great musical experience in a small format.

ai.en: The autumn holiday at Junibacken, the children's museum, from 12 October to 1 November.

events.description: Welcome to Junibacken this autumn holiday! 🍂 📆The autumn holiday stretches from October 12th to November 1st. The newly released book "Alfie plays Einstein" takes over the Pavilion, where creativity and inventive ideas flow freely. The new theatre production "What happened after that?" based on the picture book classic by Tove Jansson premieres October 16th!🎭📝 Enjoy our magical Story train, the playful exhibitions and theatre every day!

A night filled with RnB Karaoke. A space created for all RnB lovers who either want to enjoy their favorite jams out and about or have their 5 minutes of RnB fame behind the mic. Hosted by: @wonekai @ivan_thedj

During the autumn holiday at Sandhamn, activities for the whole family are offered, such as fishing on the cliffs, historical village walks, padel for children, family running, face painting, and sauna rafts every day. It also includes grilling and aperitivo in Orangeriet as well as wine glass tasting for adults.

title.en: Wilhelm Kåge & Shōji Hamada – Exhibition at Nationalmuseum

ai.en: A Nationalmuseum exhibition, open 23 April 2026 to 28 February 2027, on the ceramic work of Wilhelm Kåge and Shōji Hamada, who shared an interest in form, clay and glaze.

events.description: The exhibition at Nationalmuseum, April 23, 2026 – February 28, 2027, presents two ceramic masters united by a love of form, clay, and glaze. Kåge created beautiful everyday design for Gustavsberg, while Hamada spread the Mingei ideals of handcrafted beauty for all.

ai.en: Gallery Verso's Our Collection on Display, a showroom for its growing art collection in September and October.

events.description: During September and October, Galleri Verso will transform into a showroom for its growing art collection. We will present works we have collected over the past years alongside new artworks by artists from Sweden, the Netherlands, Morocco, and beyond.

ai.en: An advanced beer tasting with a guided tour of Omnipollos Kyrka, from the brewery through the church.

events.description: Advanced beer tasting with guided tour. This experience includes a guided tour through the entire church, from the brewery to the atelier where all our labels are created. After the tour, you’ll enjoy a tasting of six carefully selected beers: both Omnipollo classics and more exclusive varieties such as sour beers and powerful stouts. An experience for anyone who wants a deeper insight into Omnipollo’s craft, environment, and the creative process behind every bottle. Duration: approx. 2 hours.

ai.en: An autumn break at Moderna Museet with a family tour inspired by the art of Monir Shahroudy Farmanfarmaian.

events.description: During the autumn break, Moderna museet take inspiration from the art of Monir Shahroudy Farmanfarmaian. Join a family tour of the exhibition “Tehran/New York” and discover mirror mosaics, geometric forms and reflections. In the Workshop, children and adults create together using reflective materials and explore how small shapes and patterns can grow and continue almost endlessly.

ai.en: Msafiri Zawose, a Tanzanian musician known for Gogo traditional music, playing at Pygméteatern.

events.description: Msafiri Zawose is a Tanzanian musician renowned for his traditional Gogo music. He plays instruments like the zeze, ilimba, and ngoma, and his music is characterized by distinct vocal harmonies and a rich tradition from the Wagogo people of central Tanzania. He has toured internationally and continues to evolve the Gogo-fusion genre with modern elements.

Måla och Skåla (Sip and Paint) at Östgötagatan 16 or Rådmansgatan 49, both located in the city of Stockholm. Bring Your Own Beverge. The event ends with a mini art exhibition and a masterpiece to bring home!

title.en: From the City Hall tower to the silhouette of Storkyrkan

events.description: Discover central Stockholm on a guided walk including admission to Stockholm City Hall and Stockholm Cathedral. Explore the magnificent halls of City Hall, home of the Nobel Banquet, and visit the city's cathedral with its royal history, the famous Sun Dog Painting and St. George and the Dragon. The tour ends at the Royal Palace with the chance to see the changing of the guard.

ai.en: Ellas Kapell at Kafé Källtorp, a jazz quartet concert of classics and original arrangements.

events.description: The quartet invites you to a warm, playful, and intimate concert experience where jazz classics meet innovative arrangements, improvisation, and responsive ensemble playing. With great musicality and a style all their own, they honor the legacy of Ella Fitzgerald while creating something new.

title.en: Step into the World of Dinosaurs This Autumn Break

events.description: This autumn break, the Swedish Museum of Natural History is putting the spotlight on the amazing world of dinosaurs. Explore fossils, search for a missing dinosaur, get creative in the Lab, and join a pop-up guided tour of the Fossils and Evolution exhibition. And at Cosmonova, a brand-new cinematic experience awaits: Ocean Dreams, premiering on Saturday 24 October.

title.en: The Machine's Eye in Human Hands

ai.en: Photography and digital art exhibition at Fotografiska, including a photographer who fooled the world with fabricated images and an AI agent trained on the life of an artist.

events.description: A photographer fooled an entire world with fabricated images, an artist invites us to interact with an AI agent trained on her own life, childhood, and heartbreak—and in another project, new, uncanny ecosystems are created as archives and algorithms mutate into new species. In The Machine’s Eye in Human Hands at Fotografiska Stockholm, eight artists come together, each diving deeply into AI in contemporary image-making in entirely different ways.

ai.en: Det mörka ljuset by Lars Lerin at Elverket, an immersive audiovisual show by one of the Nordic region's best-loved artists.

events.description: Lars Lerin is one of the Nordic region’s most beloved and influential artists. Det mörka ljuset is an immersive audiovisual experience inviting audiences into his world of light and darkness, solitude and togetherness, longing and homecoming. Through painting, archival material, music and Lerin’s own voice, a personal story unfolds. At Elverket, the space becomes part of the journey through memories, dreams and experiences. Concept, editing & direction: Sara Broos

ai.en: An autumn butterfly house visit at Haga Ocean, with free-flying butterflies, sharks, fish, frogs and turtles.

events.description: Step into a tropical world this autumn break! Meet free-flying butterflies, sharks, fish, frogs, turtles and more. Zoologist Owe Sandström is at Fjärilshuset Oct 24–29, Oct 31 & Nov 1, with exciting animal talks and feedings. Shark Presentation, Animal of the Day, Koi Feeding, Predatory Fish Feeding and more. No programme on Oct 30.

title.en: Lantern Walk – Folklore and Beings from the age of 6

events.description: What do you see in the light of the lantern? Welcome to a walk where, in the dusk, you will walk and hear stories about what lived in the forests in the old days... The walk will take approximately 1 hour, when we arrive at the campfire and the stories continue there

title.en: Descendant. Curated by Lars von Trier

ai.en: Descendant, the autumn exhibition at the Thielska Gallery curated by Lars von Trier.

events.description: Descendant, Thielska Galleriet's major autumn exhibition, is curated by Danish film director Lars von Trier, who turns 70 in 2026. For over 40 years, Trier has renewed the art of film by challenging conventions, reinterpreting genres, and combining artistic experimentation with a distinct visual style.

ai.en: The Stockholm Beer and Whisky Festival 2026 at Nacka Strandsmässan, the original festival since 1992, with more exhibitors.

events.description: Welcome to Stockholm Beer & Whisky Festival – the original since 1992! This year, the festival is bigger, with more exhibitors and more entertainment! On 23–24 October, over 100 exhibitors gather at Nacka Strandsmässan. Discover beer, whisky, gin, rum, cocktails, wine and sparkling wine from craft breweries, distilleries and international producers. Enjoy tastings, live music and DJs – and challenge your friends to arcade games!

title.en: Family weekends at the Nobel Prize Museum

ai.en: Family weekends at the Nobel Prize Museum, with weekend activities on chemistry in which children make reactions with liquids.

events.description: Learn about chemistry by creating reactions and transforming different liquids in the museum’s weekend activity for children and families.

ai.en: A collector card festival at Stockholm Waterfront for trading cards, including Pokémon, Yu-Gi-Oh! and Magic: The Gathering.

events.description: Sweden’s most fun event for anyone interested in trading cards of all kinds. You’ll find Pokémon, YU-GI-OH, Magic: The Gathering, hockey cards, Disney Lorcana, soccer cards, Star Wars, One Piece, and many more. There are both large and small stores selling cards, as well as private sellers. You can buy, sell, and trade. Sellers and visitors will be coming from all over the country. You can also bring your collection, as there will be a large Trade Zone where you can trade with other visitors.

ai.en: Under Full Sail at Bromma Musikscen, a show of Argentine tango, opera arias and more.

events.description: Annika Listén-dance, Peter Tornborg-vocals, Jan Bark-accordion & piano. Fiery Argentine Tango, Brilliant Opera Arias, Lively See Shanties Performances accompanied by food service.

title.en: Oss Swingers Emellan (Whose Wives Are They Anyway?)

ai.en: Oss Swingers Emellan, a farce with mistaken identities at Intiman Theatre in Stockholm, starring Thomas Petersson, Måns Nathanaelson and Clara Hry.

events.description: The hilarious farce is back at Intiman Theatre in Stockholm! Following a sold-out season in Kalmar, enjoy a laugh-out-loud comedy packed with mistaken identities, outrageous lies and chaos! Starring Thomas Petersson, Måns Nathanaelson, Clara Hry, Hanna Hedlund and Charlott Strandberg. Critically acclaimed with five-star reviews! At Intiman, Stockholm. Don't miss Stockholm's funniest comedy!

ai.en: A fall break at Siggesta Gård, with a cosy hotel stay and a forest obstacle course.

events.description: Siggesta Gård offers the perfect autumn escape with a cozy hotel stay and a fun challenge in the forest obstacle course. This is the ideal spot for anyone who loves experiencing the beauty of a Swedish autumn. Highlights during the autumn break include the Pimp Your Pumpkin nature activity with Lina, sausage grilling, padel, alpaca feeding, nature crafts and much more.

title.en: Always the same – Christina, Queen of Sweden 400 years

ai.en: Always the same: Christina, Queen of Sweden, a guest performance at Confidencen celebrating 400 years since Queen Christina's birth.

events.description: A unique guest performance as part of the celebration of Swedish Queen Christina’s 400th anniversary. Deda Cristina Colonna and Mara Galassi present a musical monologue that recounts the turbulent life of Christina, Queen of Sweden (1626–1689). One of the most charismatic women of the seventeenth century, and an icon in women’s history. The performance is Confidencen's contribution to the 400th anniversary of Queen Christina's birth.

title.en: The Metro - in step with the times

ai.en: The Metro: in step with the times, an exhibition at the Stockholm Transport Museum on the metro's place in society's history.

events.description: The Metro is much more than just a way of transportation, it is also an arena and an expression of society’s values, history and social dynamics. Welcome to the amazing world of the Metro and an exhibition that tells the story of the Stockholm Metro as a way of transportation and as a cultural phenomenon.

ai.en: A design exhibition at Artipelag, created by Lidewij Edelkoort and Philip Fimmano, exploring the inner child as a source of creativity.

events.description: What happens when we dare to see the world through the curious eyes of a child? Artipelag presents a unique design exhibition exploring the inner child as a source of creativity, hope, and the joy of making. Created exclusively for Artipelag by Lidewij Edelkoort and Philip Fimmano, the exhibition brings together the work of one hundred designers and artists in an inspiring narrative about playfulness, imagination, and the human need to create with our hands.

ai.en: Gröna Lund's Halloween, an autumn of spooky experiences, rides and horror at the amusement park.

events.description: An autumn packed with spooky experiences, magical worlds, high-speed rides, and pulse-pounding horror awaits. Explore the park’s themed areas and discover this year’s new additions for both kids and grown-ups.

ai.en: An open dance class for ages 7 to 10 at the Royal Swedish Ballet School.

events.description: Royal Swedish Ballet School welcomes children aged 7–10 who are interested in dance. Participating children will have the opportunity to try classical ballet, contemporary dance, and other aspects of dance education. All in a safe and inspiring environment, together with our students, experienced teachers, and other children who share a passion for dance.

Iconic Collaborations at Sven-Harry’s Art Museum presents a groundbreaking exhibition, bringing together—for the first time—the designer collections created for H&M. The show highlights some of the most distinguished names in fashion, such as Karl Lagerfeld, Stella McCartney, Maison Martin Margiela, Kenzo, and Sonia Rykiel.

title.en: Fall break: The secrets of money

ai.en: The Secrets of Money, a fall-break exhibition at the Economy Museum on how money works and what it can buy.

events.description: What is money? What does it look like? And what can you buy with it? During the autumn holidays, you can learn how money works in a fun and playful way, with plenty of puzzles and things to figure out. Please note that all activities are held in Swedish.

Ten years of the scholarship competition The Thinking Hand has come to an end. A jubilee exhibition will open in October 2026 featuring the artists and scholarship recipients during ten years. This marks the end of the scholarship competition, which was first established to commemorate His Majesty the King’s 70th birthday in 2016. The scholarship competition and exhibition is a collaboration between the Royal Court and the Royal Academy of Fine Arts.

ai.en: Dancing Queen at ABBA The Museum, a look at how the 1976 ABBA song became a song for new generations.

events.description: Some songs belong to a time. Others continue to find new generations. When Dancing Queen was released in 1976, it quickly became a global success. Since then, it has accompanied people through generations – on dance floors, parties, weddings, concerts, and in living rooms around the world.But how was a song created that, even fifty years later, still makes people start dancing?In this exhibition, you will get closer to the story behind Dancing Queen. Through music, objects, images, and stories, you will follow the song’s journey from idea to recording to one of ABBA’s most beloved songs.

title.en: The Cinema Mystery – LasseMaja’s Detective Agency

events.description: Three dogs have disappeared in Valleby, and young detectives Lasse and Maja set out to find the mysterious dog kidnapper. The clues lead to the darkness of the local cinema, where the audience can help solve the case. Based on the book by Martin Widmark and Helena Willis, the performance is in Swedish, lasts about 45 minutes, and is recommended for children aged 5 and above.

ai.en: Jag är Ulla Winblad, an opera at Folkoperan about the woman behind Bellman's songs, set in 18th-century Stockholm, with music by Andrea Tarrodi and a libretto by Klas Östergren.

events.description: In Jag är Ulla Winblad, we meet the woman behind Bellman’s songs. When an ageing Bellman seeks out “Ulla,” memories come alive in the brutal Stockholm of the 18th century, among bustling taverns and stinking alleyways. Featuring newly composed music by Andrea Tarrodi, libretto by Klas Östergren, and direction by Nora Nilsson, the production offers a sweeping story about power, class, female identity, and the right to one’s own story – starring Björn Kjellman and Hanna Dorsin.

Need a break from your everyday routine and a good laugh? We've gathered some of the best comedians for a night of unforgettable jokes and sharp observations. Our carefully curated comedy show is back, better than ever, with ticket options to suit every budget. We recommend arriving from 18:00 if you'd like to enjoy food and drinks before the show. Age limit: 18+. Doors open at 18:00. Show starts at 19:00.

ai.en: A Yogasanas programme of 21 postures from Isha Hatha Yoga at Yogarummet Björkhagen. No special fitness is needed.

events.description: Yogasanas is a set of 21 postures, or asanas, from Isha Hatha Yoga. This programme requires no special physical agility or previous experience of yoga.. The programme is offered by Isha Foundation and taught n English. Advance registration is required through Isha Foundation's European website.

title.en: Making the Impossible Possible – Five Decades with Efva Lilja

ai.en: Making the Impossible Possible at Scenkonstmuseet, five decades of the choreographer Efva Lilja's work.

events.description: The exhibition celebrates Efva Lilja, one of Sweden’s most influential choreographers and cultural figures. Visitors can explore her groundbreaking choreographies and her lifelong exploration of body, space, and society across five decades. The exhibition presents both older and contemporary works and includes events such as guided tours, discussions, performances, and a book release.Oct 2 2026: Vernissage & Book Release – Glömskans gömslenOct 3 2026: Guided Tour and DiscussionOct 4 2026: Guided Tour and DiscussionOct 8 2026: Think, Talk, Act and Enjoy! – Performance and DiscussionOct 11 2026: PATHFINDER – Presentation and DiscussionOct 15 2026: Meet, Eat and TalkOct 22 2026: Think, Talk, Act and Enjoy! – Performance and DiscussionOct 29 2026: Meet, Eat and TalkNov 1 2026: Finissage: Guided Tour and Discussion

ai.en: UN Day at the Sjöhistoriska museet on 24 October, with talks organised by the Swedish Veterans Association.

events.description: The Swedish Veterans Association invites you to United Nations Day at Sjöhistoriska Museum, Stockholm. 15.00–16.45: Talks in Ragnar Östberg Hall. Lars Lundberg presents his book on Sweden’s civilian peace missions. Jonas Alberoth discusses the UN today and tomorrow. 16.45: Torchlight procession from the museum to the UN Monument. 17.00: Ceremony with music, speeches, a service led by Chaplain Helena Forsberg, wreath-laying and candle-lighting.

ai.en: The Sewing & Craft Festival 2026 at Stockholm Convention Center, for experienced crafters and beginners alike, with materials and inspiration.

events.description: The Sewing & Craft Festival is a natural meeting place for anyone interested in needlework and crafts. The festival caters to those with extensive knowledge who are looking for materials and inspiration, as well as curious beginners eager to learn new techniques.

ai.en: An animal tour and alpaca feeding at Siggesta Gård every Saturday and Sunday.

events.description: Every Saturday & Sunday, visitors can join an animal tour and alpaca feeding. The experience starts with a guided tour around the farm, where children can meet the animals, help groom them, clean the stables, and learn about life on the farm. It concludes with feeding the alpacas. It's a wonderful outdoor experience for both children and adults, offering the chance to get close to the animals and enjoy nature. Visitors can meet the chickens, goats, and alpacas, as well as plenty of horses and wild deer.

title.en: The Stockholm Bloodbath – Historical Outdoor Theatre

ai.en: A 55-minute outdoor historical theatre walk through Stockholm's Old Town about the Stockholm Bloodbath of 1520.

events.description: Experience one of Sweden's most dramatic historical events where it actually happened! Join a 55-minute theatrical walking tour through the cobbled streets of Stockholm's Old Town, where actors bring the Stockholm Bloodbath of 1520 to life. Meet historical figures such as Gustav Vasa, Gustav Trolle and the executioner in a story of power, betrayal and intrigue. Complete your experience with an optional historical dinner in a medieval cellar.

title.en: Guided tour of the Opera House in English

ai.en: A guided tour of the Royal Swedish Opera in English, with personal tours from guides with their own backgrounds.

events.description: All our guides have different backgrounds and special interests, so the tours are always very personal. Someone has danced at the Opera for 20 years, another has studied art in depth and a third knows ALL about Gustav III, who established the Royal Swedish Opera in 1773 and who built the country's first opera house, in which he was later murdered in 1792.

ai.en: Halloween in Mariefred, a family fall-break event with a ghost train and Halloween activities in the town.

events.description: Mariefred celebrates Fall Break and Halloween with both a Ghost Train and a Halloween Day in town for the whole family, featuring fiskdamm, a witch-led quiz walk, and much more.

ai.en: Amon Amarth's Allfather Awaken tour at Hovet, the Viking metal band returning home to Sweden.

events.description: Amon Amarth, the undisputed kings of Viking metal, return home to Sweden in 2026 with their new massive tour, The Allfather Awakens Tour. Since their start in Tumba in 1992, the band has built an unparalleled legacy, establishing themselves as one of the world’s largest and most influential metal bands. With their unique blend of melodic death metal, monumental choruses, and stories drawn from Norse mythology, they have created the soundtrack for generations of battle and triumph through classics like *Once Sent From the Golden Hall*, *Twilight of the Thunder God*, and *Jomsviking*.

ai.en: Children's Saturdays at the Royal Swedish Opera, concerts and baroque dance for children. Tickets must be reserved.

events.description: Note: Tickets must be reserved, more info in the link below. Welcome to the Children's Saturdays; concerts, try out baroque dancing, try opera singing or why not join a guided tour of the Opera House and try on costumes from the costume department... Or try out balle! Memorable experiences for the whole family!

title.en: Friends of Chamber Music at Allhelgonakyrkan

ai.en: Pianist Bengt Forsberg plays Bach transcriptions by Rachmaninov, Busoni, Godowsky and others at Allhelgonakyrkan, for Friends of Chamber Music.

events.description: Pianist Bengt Forsberg performs transcriptions of works of Johan Sebastian Bach by Rachmaninov, Busoni, Godowsky, Grainger, and others.

ai.en: OBS., an exhibition at Marabouparken by fifteen final-year students from Konstfack, exploring making, seeing and knowing.

events.description: The exhibition brings together fifteen students in their final year at Konstfack. Fifteen different practices, fifteen ways of seeing, making, thinking and doubting. Knowledge emerges between them: between people, materials, technologies and institutions. In that strange space in between, where something has not yet been determined.

ai.en: A family show at Elverket about dinosaurs, presented at life size in a 360-degree experience during the autumn break.

events.description: Bring the whole family on an exciting and educational journey back in time to the world of dinosaurs! Experience these prehistoric giants at life-size scale in a spectacular 360° experience that combines fascinating facts, drama and wonder. During the autumn break, Elverket is adding extra shows and will also be open on Monday!

ai.en: Nordic Moments at the Nordic Museum, an evolving display of photography collections, opening with Metamorphoses.

events.description: Nordic Moments at the Nordic Museum highlights photographic collections in an evolving presentation. The opening exhibition Metamorphoses displays negatives rescued from the project 100,000 Photo Memories, where time and chemistry created new visual expressions. On view from October 17, 2025.

title.en: Ndidi Dike – Rare Earth Rare Justice

events.description: Färgfabriken is proud to present an exhibition by British-Nigerian artist Ndidi Dike. Rare Earth Rare Justice addresses questions of extraction and postcolonial structures while offering a powerful visual experience in Färgfabriken’s Main Hall.

ai.en: Asteroid Hunters at Cosmonova, the Swedish Museum of Natural History, on how science can deal with asteroids that reach Earth.

events.description: Most of them never reach Earth, but how should we deal with those that do? Discover how science and technology can help us outsmart one of the world’s most preventable natural disasters and protect our planet. Could a supercomputer be part of the solution? Journey into space for a fascinating look at asteroids, their cosmic origins, and the potential threat they pose to our world in Asteroid Hunters at Cosmonova.

title.en: Antiques and vintage market at Karlaplan

events.description: Great market for both antiques bargaining and second hand jeans! This flea market is extremely popular on TikTok :) New vendors every Saturday (about 100 every day) so great potential for finding real treasures. You'll find the market in the park around the fountain of Karlaplan. Stroll through the market, have a fika and enjoy a day in the park.

ai.en: Autumn break at Tekniska museet, with creative lab activities such as Forest Rave and a space academy.

events.description: Spend the autumn break exploring, creating and experimenting together. Join Creative Kids Lab: Forest Rave, train at the Space Academy, try new musical instruments and test game prototypes from KTH. There’s also live music, the robot dog, the model railway, pop-up tours in Dreamland and immersive space adventures in Wisdome. Add the museum’s many exhibitions – from Teknoleket and MegaMind to The Forest and Play Beyond Play – and there’s plenty to discover for the whole family.

ai.en: Chamber/Cacti at the Royal Swedish Opera, two 30-minute modern dance pieces with kinetic energy and humour, by Medhi Walerski.

events.description: Kinetic energy, humour, precision and collective power, in two 30-minute sessions of modern dance expression. Medhi Walerski’s almost ritualistic work Chamber makes its first appearance on stage in Sweden, here in tandem with Cacti – one of many expressive works by Alexander Ekman.

title.en: Autumn Kayaking, Swedish Fika & Hot Sauna

ai.en: An autumn kayak trip in the Stockholm archipelago, with a Swedish fika and a hot sauna, from Skärgårdens Kanotcenter.

events.description: Golden leaves, crisp air and peaceful waters – discover autumn in the Stockholm Archipelago by kayak. Explore colourful islands near Vaxholm with a local guide and pause for Swedish fika in nature. Round off your adventure with an optional hot wood-fired sauna. Beginners are welcome, and all kayaking equipment is included. Pick-up is also available. A beautiful way to enjoy the archipelago in September and October!

ai.en: A family party at Tyrol in Stockholm with an ABBA-themed Mamma Mia show, a Mediterranean menu and a show adapted for children from age 8.

events.description: YAMAS! 10 ÅR MED MAGISKA FESTKVÄLLAR Välkomna till vår Familjefest med något anpassad show (bl.a. ljudvolymen) så att barn från 8 år kan följa med! En grekisk taverna. En medelhavsmeny (en smula uppdaterad för att tilltala även våra yngre gäster). ABBAs låtar och en festkänsla som aldrig tar slut! På vår Familjefest finns det barnbiljetter för de mellan 8-15 år. Barn som är 8 år eller äldre är varmt välkomna till tavernan. Små barn (även spädbarn) får tyvärr stanna hemma. Från 16 år och uppåt köper man biljett till ordinarie pris. Samtliga gäster på partyt behöver inneha en egen biljett och alla under 18 år måste vara i målsmans sällskap. Entré: 14.00-14.45. Man behöver inte komma till Tyrol innan ankomsttiden. Längd: Räkna med minst 4 tim från att dörrarna öppnas men sen är det upp till dig själv hur länge du vill vara kvar på dansgolvet. Alla personer i din bokning placeras tillsammans. Om ni köper biljetter vid olika tillfällen går det bra att få platserna tillsammans men det måste anmälas via mejl till ticket@mammamiatheparty.se. Bordsplaceringen är klar när ni anländer. Behöver du anmäla en allergi eller ett kostbehov så mailar du restaurangen på food@mammamiatheparty.se. Tänk på att ange bokningsnummer, datum ni kommer samt namn det är bokat i. Rullstolsplats köper du via Ticketmasters tillgänglighetslinje 0776-70 77 77. Ledsagare behöver också biljett men betalar endast för maten. Åldersgräns 18 år (8-17 år ok i målsmans sällskap). Med reservation för att medverkande…

org.name: MM! The Party in Stockholm AB

title.en: Work in Progress – Jesper Rönndahl och Marie Agerhäll

ai.en: A work-in-progress showing at PIK Vasastan with Jesper Rönndahl and Marie Agerhäll, testing material for their production Detta ser man fram emot. Recommended from age 13.

events.description: Kom och se Jesper Rönndahl och Marie Agerhäll testa och finslipa material inför föreställningen "Detta ser man fram emot". Längd: ca 80 min, ingen paus Åldersgräns: 13 år (rekommenderad) Arrangör: All Things Live Läs våra köpvillkor här!

ai.en: PIAF! The Show at Göta Lejon, a stage show celebrating the French singer Édith Piaf.

events.description: PIAF! - The Show is a stage performance celebrating the legendary French singer Édith Piaf. The experience takes the audience on a journey through her life and career, filled with emotion, drama, and iconic songs. The show takes place at the historic Göta Lejon theater in central Stockholm.

ai.en: A wheel-throwing pottery workshop at The Creativity House, for beginners in individual, couple or small-group sessions.

events.description: Learn to wheel-throw in a mixed group. Suitable for individuals, couples, or small groups. Beginner level – but anyone who's thrown on a wheel before is also warmly welcome! A pottery instructor will guide you and help you during the entire session, step by step. Make, for example, a bowl, cup, candle holder, etc. You get unlimited tries and can keep 3 pieces per person.

title.en: Dinner in Darkness in Old town

ai.en: Dinner in Darkness in Gamla Stan, a dining experience in the dark beneath the Old Town's streets.

events.description: Step into the darkness beneath the charming old streets of Gamla Stan, Stockholm, for a truly unique dining experience. In a cozy medieval cellar vault, you will enjoy a two-course dinner served in complete darkness. Without sight, your senses are heightened as you try to guess what you are eating and drinking throughout the evening. A fun, immersive, and unforgettable experience unlike any ordinary dinner.

ai.en: Pink.White.Blue. at Södergården, a meet-up for trans, non-binary and agender young adults aged 18 to 30, with fika.

events.description: A meeting place for young adults aged 18-30 who are trans, non-binary or agender. The event offers fika (coffee and cookies), board games and a range of activities based on suggestions from visitors. These include weaving, role-playing sessions, discussions on various topics and networking opportunities. The goal is to support trans people in building relationships and safe networks, while providing meeting spaces free from alcohol and drugs.

ai.en: The Stockholm Sangeet Festival main concert at Eric Ericssonhallen, celebrating 20 years of South Asian classical music.

events.description: Scandinavia's foremost festival for South Asian classical music celebrates 20 years! Experience the 136 stringed Sopori santoor at the highest level performed by the master Abhay Sopori, accompanied on tabla by Nihar Mehta. Be treated to an exquisite violin recital by Nandini Shankar, one of the celebrated granddaugthers of the legendary Dr N Rajam, accompanied by tabla master Suranjana Ghosh. Also enjoy hot chai, photo exhibition and artwork by Annika Heed.

ai.en: The Troll-Futuristic City Planning Office, an autumn 2026 installation next to Färgfabriken.

events.description: In autumn 2026, the Troll-Futuristic City Planning Office will open on a site next to Färgfabriken. Welcome all visitors, small and big, for the public helping days. The Troll-Futurist City Planning Office is run by Thérèse Kristiansson of MYCKET as part of her doctoral research in urban design at KTH, within the research project Ecologies of Care (EcoCARE).

title.en: Car boot sale in Kista galleria parking garage

ai.en: A large car boot sale in the parking garage of Kista galleria, where Stockholmers sell second-hand clothes, vintage, toys and antiques.

events.description: Huge car boot sale at Kista galleria's parking garage (Östra p-huset). Come find your own true treasures among car loads of things at this very very popular flea market where Stockholmers can come and sell what they no longer need. From second hand clothes to vintage, from toys to antiques! Come early - or late for best bargain potential!

ai.en: Maxida Märak in concert at Scalateatern, launching her album Ögonblick.

events.description: This autumn, Maxida Märak releases her new album Ögonblick with an exclusive concert at Scalateatern in Stockholm. Ögonblick brings Maxida closer to her roots, putting vocals, lyrics, and live instruments center stage in music bridging personal thoughts and contemporary issues. Expect new songs alongside favorite classics—an evening of powerful lyrics, presence, and an artist who always does things her own way. Welcome to an evening with Maxida Märak!

ai.en: Puscifer at Annexet, the musical project of Maynard James Keenan, Mat Mitchell and Carina Round.

events.description: Puscifer is a creative universe of its own, where Maynard James Keenan, Mat Mitchell and Carina Round merge music, aesthetics, role-playing and dark humour into something unique, edgy and deeply inviting. The trio themselves describe the project as a forum for sonic and visual storytelling, where albums, tours, characters and performances all form part of the same larger world.

title.en: Family Guided Tour: Myths at Millesgården

ai.en: A family guided tour at Millesgården, Myths, among the gods, heroes and monsters of Carl and Olga Milles's sculptures.

events.description: Step into the ancient world of the gods, among deities, heroes and monsters. Discover the sculptures of Carl and Olga Milles, who shaped Millesgården together. Carl’s works inspired by myths and legends await in the beautiful sculpture park. The tour is held in Swedish.

title.en: The Hurried One – If We Have Time!

ai.en: The Hurried One at Kristinehovs Malmgård, a Swedish-language adaptation of Ludvig Holberg's farce Den Stundesløse.

events.description: A vibrant new adaptation of Ludvig Holberg’s strikingly relevant farce Den Stundesløse. Performed in swedish.

title.en: Sound Healing Concert with Harmonic Sounds & Guests

ai.en: A sound healing closing concert with Harmonic Sounds, Michele Averard and Nestor Kornblum at Solnahallen.

events.description: Experience a special closing concert with Harmonic Sounds, Michele Averard and Nestor Kornblum, joined by guest artists. Through voices, overtone singing and various instruments, they create a musical experience filled with beautiful sounds and harmonies. They will also offer concerts and workshops throughout the weekend. Included in the Harmony Expo admission.

Born in Peru and raised in Harlem, Immortal Technique has built a strong international following since the early 2000s through his uncompromising independent hip-hop. With razor-sharp social commentary, politically charged lyrics and intense storytelling, he has become a cult figure in the underground scene – not least through albums such as Revolutionary Vol. 1, Revolutionary Vol. 2 and The 3rd World.

ai.en: American football on the big screen every Sunday evening at Hard Rock Cafe Stockholm.

events.description: American Football Sundays at Hard Rock Cafe Stockholm Every Sunday evening, join us for American football on the big screens at Hard Rock Cafe Stockholm, in collaboration with NFL Podden. Gather your friends, follow the games and enjoy a great Sunday evening with good food, drinks and live sports.

title.en: Opera during Autumn Market at Ulriksdal

ai.en: Opera concerts at Confidencen during the Ulriksdal Autumn Market, with three soloists and a 10-piece orchestra.

events.description: Opera Concerts at Confidencen – a favourite returns during the Ulriksdal Autumn Market! Three soloists and a 10-piece orchestra present gems from Mozart to Verdi. Three concerts on Sunday, combine with a guided tour of the theatre.

title.en: Children of the Forest (1–3 years old)

events.description: Children of the Forest, freely inspired by Elsa Beskow’s beloved tale, is a joyful celebration of a young child’s world through the changing seasons. As we grow, play and explore, we discover ourselves, each other and the magic of everyday life. A bold, techno-infused visual performance for ages 1–3 and their grown-ups, celebrating curiosity, connection and the joy of being together.

ai.en: A baroque concert at Högalidskyrkan in Stockholm, with Kammarkören Högalid and the Johann Sebastian Bach-Chor from Hamburg, performing Zelenka, Bernhard and Bach.

events.description: Kammarkören Högalid and Johann Sebastian Bach-Chor from Hamburg join forces for a Baroque concert. The programme features Zelenka's Missa Sancti Josephi, Bernhard's Herr, nun lässest du deinen Diener and Bach's cantata Gott der Herr ist Sonn und Schild, BWV 79. The concert is part of the choirs' musical exchange in autumn 2026. Free admission.

title.en: Explore the Old Town with Cityquizwalks (Family Friendly)

ai.en: A family-friendly Old Town walk with Cityquizwalks, where two characters pose questions as the group explores.

events.description: Join Alice and Viktor on a journey of discovery through Stockholm’s Old Town. They have many questions as they make their way through streets and narrow alleys with unusual names. This walk is intended for families with children aged 10 to 15. The questions and texts should be neither too easy nor too difficult. Start: Mälartorget, Gamla stan. Distance & time: approx. 2 km and 2 hours (hills, steps, cobblestones). Children up to 15 years old free of charge with their parents.

ai.en: Deep Purple at Avicii Arena in Stockholm, with Ticketmaster Platinum tickets available only on Ticketmaster.se, limited to 10 per person.

events.description: Till det här evenemanget kan du köpa Ticketmaster Platinumbiljetter. • Begränsat antal och endast tillgängligt på Ticketmaster.se. • Max 10 st biljetter per person.

ai.en: A poetry and music evening at Restaurang Strand 54, with actress Ingela Karlsson reading from Carinne L-Williams's book.

events.description: Actress Ingela Karlsson will read from Carinne L-Williams’s book as well as her own poems. Songwriter Caroline Williams will perform her own musical settings of well-known poems and gospel songs. Artist and performer Martina M. Orlop will sing songs associated with Zarah Leander. Songwriters Claes Lewerin and Jane Helen will provide entertainment. Free admission.

ai.en: Joyful Mondays at Yeshin Norbu Meditation Center, with free fika, conversation and meditation each Monday.

events.description: A relaxed space to meet new people and connect awaits every Monday at Yeshin Norbu. Free fika, meaningful conversations and community come together in a welcoming setting. Conversation starters help break the ice, while a guided meditation offers a moment of calm. Join in person or online – no registration required. Everyone is welcome.

ai.en: A family workshop at the Nobel Prize Museum, with a guided tour of the medical exhibition Cells, Nerves, Genes, followed by watercolour painting of cells led by a Karolinska Institutet researcher.

events.description: Welcome to a workshop for the whole family! The programme begins with a guided tour of the medical history exhibition Cells, Nerves, Genes. Afterwards, Ina Schuppe Koistinen, a researcher at Karolinska Institutet and a practising watercolour artist, teaches us how to paint cells using watercolours. During the day ,we observe cells through a microscope and hear stories about Nobel Prize laureates connected to the topic.

title.en: Autumn Camp for Kids in Stockholm 2026 (5-14 years)

ai.en: An autumn camp for children aged 5 to 14 at the British International School, combining STEAM, sport and creative activities.

events.description: GowReads Autumn Camp combines STEAM, sports and creative activities. Children can choose from LEGO Robotics, Roblox, Minecraft Coding, T-shirt painting, jewellery making, clay modelling, football, basketball, dodgeball, board games and surprise themes. A special candy-making workshop includes transport to a professional kitchen. The camp is conducted in English with Swedish support.

ai.en: Holiday activities for young people at the Royal Swedish Opera during the autumn, Christmas and spring breaks.

events.description: The Young Opera section invites you to exciting holiday activities in the Opera House during the autumn, Christmas, sports and Easter holidays! Concerts, costume fittings, trying out instruments, guided tours – every school holiday the youngest can dive in behind the scenes and discover what it is that makes a theater come to life.

ai.en: An outdoor circuit-training workout run by SATS Kista at Stenbecks Square, free and high intensity.

events.description: SATS will be hosting circuit training for everyone outside in the fresh air at Stenbecks Square! A really high-intensity session in a circuit training format. The session is specially designed for those of you who train at the gym, enjoy working out in smaller groups. Bring your colleagues, friend, or partner and enjoy moving outdoors!

ai.en: Adventure Week at Downtown Camper by Scandic, a limited autumn break programme for curious and adventurous families.

events.description: Welcome to Adventure Week this autumn break, a limited-edition program for curious minds and adventurous spirits. From rooftop yoga and climbing to mini expeditions into the wild, there's something for every kind of explorer. All activities are complimentary, and primarily for staying hotel guests. Book your stay and sign up to secure your spot. Non-hotel guests are welcome to join the waitlist and will be admitted subject to availability.

title.en: Guided tours of the Riksdag (in Swedish)

ai.en: Guided tours of the Riksdag buildings in Swedish, covering the work of the Swedish parliament.

events.description: Open tours of the Riksdag buildings are offered to the public. During these tours, visitors can learn about the tasks and work of the Riksdag. The tour includes visits to various rooms that play an important role in the Riksdag’s work. The tour is free of charge and open to everyone. It is not possible to book tickets in advance. Please arrive with enough time for a security check

ai.en: An autumn break at Tolv Stockholm, a family entertainment arena beneath the Globe.

events.description: Fun for the whole family during the autumn school break at Tolv, Sweden’s largest entertainment arena, located beneath 3Arena. Loads of activities for kids of all ages to choose from. How about bowling, adventure golf, arcade games and much more?

title.en: Guided tours of the Riksdag (in English)

ai.en: Guided tours of the Riksdag buildings in English, covering the work of the Swedish parliament.

events.description: Open tours of the Riksdag buildings are offered to the public. During these tours, visitors can learn about the tasks and work of the Riksdag. The tour includes visits to various rooms that play an important role in the Riksdag’s work. The tour is free of charge and open to everyone. It is not possible to book tickets in advance. Please arrive with enough time for a security check.

ai.en: An author talk with Carl-Johan Vallgren at Kulturhuset Stadsteatern, one of several autumn events with Swedish writers and musicians.

events.description: This fall at Kulturhuset Stadsteatern, you’ll have the opportunity to meet Swedish authors and musicians who will discuss how their songwriting intersects with literary storytelling. On October 26, acclaimed artist and songwriter Carl-Johan Vallgren will join us for a conversation with Poul Perris, focusing on "Kärleken", an autobiographical novel about love, illness, and life’s unpredictability.

title.en: Autumn break at City Hall – Family Tour and Crafts

ai.en: An autumn break family tour at Stockholm City Hall, looking at animals in the building's art, with crafts.

events.description: This autumn break, come and explore the world of animals at City Hall! Did you know that animals are depicted throughout the building, on walls, ceilings and various objects? During a guided family tour with an animal theme, we’ll discover some of them together in the Blue Hall and the Golden Hall. After the tour, children can get creative and colour in their own animal masks. Don’t forget to look for the hidden animals in the City Hall Park, too!

title.en: Deep Purple - Live in Stockholm, Avicii Arena

events.description: Deep Purple arrives in Stockholm on October 26, 2026, for a highly anticipated concert at Avicii Arena. With more than five decades at the top of the rock scene, the band continues to impress audiences with their energy, signature sound, and timeless classics like “Smoke on the Water.”Fans can expect a powerful live show filled with exceptional musicianship and a mix of iconic hits and newer material. Opening the night is the young UK rock band JAYLER.This will be one of the major rock events of the autumn in Stockholm – a chance to experience one of the world’s most iconic bands live.

ai.en: A night tour at the Nordic Museum during the autumn break, with tours between 18:30 and 21:00 of about 50 minutes each, with adult accompaniment.

events.description: What really happens at the Nordic Museum when darkness falls? Rumours suggest that everything comes alive at night. During the autumn break, you have the chance to find out during an evening full of mystery. Tours with various start times between 18:30‑21:00, about 50 minutes long, with adult accompaniment for children from age 6.

title.en: Stockholm Run Club at Clarion Hotel Sign

ai.en: A Tuesday evening run through central Stockholm with Stockholm Running Club, leaving at 18:00 from the Clarion Hotel Sign.

events.description: Experience better runs – Join Stockholm Running Club for a run through central Stockholm. Every Tuesday at 18:00, meeting point at Clarion Hotel® Sign. After the run, stick around for After Run in the bar with special prices.

title.en: Funkamix – Festival for Kids Youth with Disabilities

ai.en: Funkamix, a free festival for children and young people with disabilities in Skärholmen, with sport and culture.

events.description: Funkamix is back in Skärholmen. Following last year's success with 313 participants, this free festival brings sports, culture, and leisure activities to children and youth with disabilities (ages 7–25). Organized and run by Skärholmen Library and the Sports Administration in collaboration with 30+ partner organizations.

title.en: Halloween Night. A Haunting String Quartet Recital

ai.en: Halloween Night, a haunting string quartet recital at Bio Skandia.

events.description: Step into a hauntingly beautiful world where unforgettable music creates a truly mesmerizing Halloween atmosphere. This captivating string quartet recital brings to life the most mysterious and beloved melodies from film, television, and musical theatre. The program features iconic music from Stranger Things, Dark Selection, Wednesday, The Addams Family, unforgettable themes from Tim Burton's films, and many more haunting masterpieces.

A beer tasting where you’ll get to know Omnipollo’s brewery and its most classic beers. We begin with a short tour of the brewery, where we explain the basics of the brewing process and Omnipollo’s philosophy. After the tour, you’ll take part in a guided tasting of four beers from Omnipollo’s classic selection. A perfect first introduction for anyone who wants to learn more about how craft beer is made and how different styles vary in flavour and character. Duration: approx. 1 h 15 min.

title.en: Autumn Half-Term Workshop: Create Your Own Face Mask

ai.en: An autumn half-term face-mask workshop at Artipelag, inspired by the INNER CHILD exhibition.

events.description: Create your own face mask in a creative workshop inspired by the exhibition INNER CHILD: Playing with Design! Drawing inspiration from the exhibition’s playful approach to design, participants create their own masks using different materials and techniques, experimenting and exploring together. The workshop takes place during the autumn half-term holiday and is led by Artipelag’s experienced art hosts. For children aged 6–12.

title.en: Stockholm Culture Exchange & Make New Friends

ai.en: A social gathering at Trolls Stockholm for internationals, expats, travellers and locals to meet and make friends.

events.description: A social gathering where internationals, expats, travelers, and locals come together to meet new people and build meaningful connections in a relaxed and welcoming atmosphere. The event offers opportunities to discuss culture, travel, languages, and life in Stockholm while enjoying a friendly and inclusive environment. Everyone is welcome, regardless of background or language level. After 10 PM, the evening continues with karaoke for those who would like to sing or simply enjoy the atmosphere

ai.en: The Stockholm International Poetry Festival 2026 at Scalateatern, marking its 30th anniversary.

events.description: Welcome to the Stockholm International Poetry Festival 2026, as 20TAL celebrates the festival’s 30th anniversary with a vibrant stage show on the Main Stage at Scalateatern on 27 October! Under this year’s theme, »SPIN, MY WORLD – magic, ecology, world poetry«, poets from across the globe come together with Swedish writers, musicians and performing artists in a series of innovative performances.

ai.en: Naomi Sharon at Debaser Strand, alternative R&B, soul and cinematic soundscapes.

events.description: Naomi Sharon returns to Stockholm with her atmospheric blend of alternative R&B, soul and cinematic soundscapes. As the first female artist signed to OVO Sound, the Rotterdam-born singer has earned acclaim for her warm vocals and emotionally rich songwriting. Expect an intimate live show where modern production meets soulful melodies in one of today's most exciting contemporary R&B performances.

ai.en: Tosca at the Royal Swedish Opera, a classic opera about a dramatic 24 hours in Rome.

events.description: Deadly drama, sparkling singing and classic stage design. During a dramatic 24 hours we follow the three main characters in a story of life and death, accompanied by surgingly beautiful music, in a classic performance. Tosca is the opera that has it all, here produced with a grand set design, a large chorus and some of the best loved duets in operatic history.

title.en: Meet the Power, Take the Power – Children's Fair (no Adults)

events.description: The children's rights fair Meet the Power, Take the Power is a meeting place for young people aged 10 to 17, where they can ask questions, express opinions, and meet people with power and influence. The fair includes exhibitors such as the Police Authority, the Children's Ombudsman, Bris, and BUP, as well as discussions, stage performances, and a creative workshop.

ai.en: A guided walking tour (in Swedish) of the former prison on Långholmen, with lunch.

events.description: Join a guided walking tour (in Swedish) of the former prison on Långholmen in Stockholm and learn about the island’s eventful 250-year prison history. After the tour, a selected lunch is served at Långholmens restaurant.

title.en: Tigers - Inspired by the Books about Loranga, Masarin and Dartanjang by Barbro Lindgren (2.5-6 years)

ai.en: Tigers, a Teater Tre children's show based on the Loranga, Masarin and Dartanjang books, an adventure through a forest.

events.description: Join an adventure through the forest, past the scrap yard and the giraffe, to Masarin’s home. Dad Loranga sleeps under the kitchen table, Grandpa Dartanjang takes his temperature in the woodshed – but what is that rumbling in the distance? Tigers! Are they dangerous or funny? Tigers roar, stars twinkle, and the summer never ends. Let yourself be swept away by tiger hunts, pretend bullfights and car races in this physical comedy about being strong, scared and almost happy.

ai.en: Kongo Groove Festival 2026, a festival of African and Afro-diasporic music, arts and culture in several places across Greater Stockholm.

events.description: Kongo Groove Festival 2026 – An International Festival Celebrating African and Afro-Diasporic Music, Arts, Culture, Youth, Creativity and Intercultural Exchange. The event will be in different places in the Greater Stockholm Metropolitan: Subtopia, Fisksätra Folkets hus, Punkt Medis, Haninge Kulturhus, Bromma Folkhögskola.

title.en: The History Detectives: The Mystery of the Snoring Widow

ai.en: The History Detectives: The Mystery of the Snoring Widow, a family detective activity at the City Museum, looking for a plague cure in the old building.

events.description: Together with the City Museum’s Time Guardian, we search the old building for a recipe that can cure the plague. Suitable for children aged 7 and up. Book a free ticket. (in Swedish)

title.en: Ghost tour for the whole family

ai.en: A family ghost tour of the Stockholm City Museum's old house, with flour sacks, rats and other historic surprises.

events.description: What horrors might our old house be hiding? Come along and find out! We’ll tread carefully among flour sacks and rats, and visit the theater’s ghost and the White Lady of the castle. Ages 7 and up. Book a free ticket.

title.en: The History Detectives: The Mystery of the Missing Nightingale

ai.en: The History Detectives: The Mystery of the Missing Nightingale at the City Museum, a time-travel mystery to find a lost singer.

events.description: One of the world’s most beautiful voices is gone. Now, a time-traveling caretaker wants us to solve the mystery and find the voice. Ages 7 and up. Book a free ticket. (in Swedish)

ai.en: DJ Krush, the Japanese trip-hop and abstract hip-hop pioneer, playing at Kollektivet Livet in Stockholm on 28 October.

events.description: Det finns få artister, DJs och producenter med en lika imponerande och inflytelserik karriär som den legendariska DJ Krush från Japan. Han räknas av många som en av pionjärerna inom trip-hop och abstrakt hiphop-- och den 28 oktober kommer han äntligen till Stockholm. Den legendariske DJ:n från Japan inspirerades starkt av kultfilmen Wild Style under 80-talet, vilket blev startskottet för hans resa inom hiphop. Han började med grupperna B-FRESH3 och senare KRUSH POSSE -- en av Japans mest banbrytande hiphopakter med sin unika 1MC/2DJ-konstellation. När gruppen upplöstes 1992 tog han steget fullt ut som soloartist. Sedan dess har DJ Krush skapat ett helt eget musikaliskt uttryck där DJ-konsten står i centrum. Under mitten av 90-talet fick han internationellt genomslag med debutalbumet KRUSH och det hyllade Strictly Turntablized, släppt via brittiska Mo' Wax. Genom åren har han samarbetat med både underground- och världskända artister och cementerat sin roll som en nyckelfigur inom global trip-hop och abstrakt hiphop. Med nästan 40 år på scen har han turnerat världen över, spelat i mer än 60 länder och över 350 städer, samt uppträtt på ikoniska festivaler som Glastonbury, Sónar och Coachella. Hans senaste album Saisei (2024) möttes av stark respons från fans världen över och visar att han fortfarande är lika relevant som någonsin. Såvitt vi vet har DJ Krush aldrig spelat i Stockholm -- eller åtminstone inte på väldigt länge. Därför känns det extra stort att äntligen få välkomna…

title.en: Historical beer walk at Södermalm + Beer tasting

ai.en: A historical beer walk through Södermalm's former industrial areas, with a beer tasting at Ringvägen 117.

events.description: Do you want to join us on an exciting beer walk through Södermalm's former industrial areas, where old breweries once stood? Let the guide take you on a journey back in time with stories about the origins of the beer and its connection to the history of the area. During the walk, you will see pictures from the 18th century to the first half of the 20th century. After an exciting tour, beer tasting awaits at a secret location, where you will enjoy fantastic beers and discover new favorites.

ai.en: Robyn Hitchcock at Debaser Strand in October, a songwriter with a catalogue spanning six decades.

events.description: Robyn Hitchcock performs at Debaser Strand in October. With a career spanning six decades, he has built a singular catalogue where psychedelic rock, pop and surrealism meet. From The Soft Boys to acclaimed solo albums, Hitchcock remains one of music’s most distinctive voices. Expect a charismatic and deeply personal live performance.

title.en: After Hours – Art Evenings at Artipelag

ai.en: After Hours at Artipelag, art evenings from 17:00 to 21:00 on selected Wednesdays.

events.description: When the day ends, the evening begins at Artipelag. Welcome to After Hours! On selected Wednesdays from 5–9 pm, Artipelag invites you to an evening of art, music, food and drinks in the Stockholm archipelago. Meet up with friends or colleagues and experience MUCHA – Beyond Art Nouveau after regular opening hours. A direct bus departs from Cityterminalen at 5.30 pm and returns from Artipelag at 9 pm.

ai.en: A Wednesday bar quiz at Downtown Camper from 18:00, with quiz, music and drinks.

events.description: Quiz, music and great vibes – every Wednesday at Downtown Camper! At 18:00, the bar transforms into a buzzing quiz scene as Georg Ekelund – a globally seasoned DJ – takes over the music. Expect great vibes, tricky questions, and some very nice prizes to win. Gather your friends, sharpen your music memory, and get ready for an evening filled with laughs, friendly competition, and good energy – every Wednesday in the bar at Downtown Camper. Free of charge, no sign-up required.

title.en: Miles Davis 100 Years – Milestones & Kind of Blue

ai.en: Miles Davis at 100, a tribute concert at Fasching with a sextet, marking what would have been his 100th birthday.

events.description: In 2026, Miles Davis would have turned 100 years old.
