This concert pays tribute to the jazz giant with a sextet led by trumpeter Samuel Olsson, performing two of his most significant albums: *Milestones* (1958) and *Kind of Blue* (1959). *Milestones* is considered one of the first modal jazz compositions, while *Kind of Blue* defined the new modal jazz and remains the best-selling jazz album of all time.

ai.en: An oyster cart at Americain, the award-winning bar at Haymarket by Scandic, serving oysters every Wednesday.

events.description: Every Wednesday, the oyster cart enters Americain, Haymarket’s award-winning bar. Serving fresh pearls chucked to order at a friendly price on oysters. As always during after-work hours, Haymarket's DJs set the soundtrack and atmosphere for the evening. Free admission. No booking required. Seating is limited so come early.

ai.en: Stockholm Comedy Club unfiltered at Gamestreet 1 every other Wednesday, with live podcasting and stand-up.

events.description: Every other Wednesday at Gamestreet 1! Join us for an evening of live podcasting, stand-up comedy and great after-work vibes. We kick things off with Stockholm Comedy Club Ofiltrerat live on stage, followed by a fast-paced stand-up show featuring both rising and established comedians. Free entry!

ai.en: Svensk Kortfilm at Folkets Bio, a selection of Swedish short films shown in cinemas during autumn 2026.

events.description: The short films are returning to cinemas! During the fall of 2026, Svensk Kortfilm c/o Folkets Bio offers some of the best short films, noticed and shown at film festivals around the world. For six Wednesdays starting October 7th at Zita Folkets Bio, exclusive premiere screenings with both director talks and mingle will be offered! All premiere events are free. For more info, see the link below.

title.en: Elina Du Rietz and Friends – Stand-up Comedy in Swedish

ai.en: Elina Du Rietz and friends in Swedish stand-up comedy at Teater Bristol, with Ann Westin and Behrad Rouzbeh.

events.description: Swedish comedian and actor Elina Du Rietz is joined by Ann Westin and Behrad Rouzbeh for an evening of stand-up comedy. The three comedians combine self-irony, physical comedy, improvisation and sharp observations of everyday life. They are known from major Swedish comedy stages and television programmes including Solsidan, Bäst i test, Parlamentet and IFS. The performance is in Swedish.

ai.en: Bear Garden at Debaser Nova, a band mixing saxophone and harmonies with hip hop, pop, psychedelia and jazz.

events.description: Saxophone, pounding drums, and soaring vocal harmonies collide with influences from hip-hop, pop, psychedelia, and jazz! The acclaimed Bear Garden returns to Debaser – and anyone who caught them there in 2022 knows this is an artist you need to experience live.

ai.en: Wilma Vidal at Haymarket by Scandic, a Wednesday stage at Americain for up-and-coming Swedish comedians.

events.description: Every Wednesday, Americain transforms into Haymarket's very own live stage, spotlighting the next generation of Swedish music. Part candy, part punk, Wilma Vidal pairs raw rock energy with melancholic pop melodies and emotionally stripped-back songwriting. Already known as an actor and creative talent, she now steps into music with a sound that feels both fiercely personal and unmistakably her own. Discover one of Sweden's most exciting new voices - before everyone else does.

ai.en: Paradise Lost on Södermalm, a frightening city walk through plague and murder, for ages 12 and up.

events.description: Mörkret har fallit över Södermalm i en fasansfull stadsvandring bland likdelar, pest och styckmord. Åldersgräns 12 år.

title.en: Behemoth & Dimmu Borgir – In League with Satan Tour

ai.en: Behemoth and Dimmu Borgir's In League with Satan tour at B-K in October, a co-headlining extreme metal tour.

events.description: In October 2026, two of the most influential extreme metal bands will join forces for a monumental co-headlining tour. Behemoth and Dimmu Borgir comes to Europe with their In League with Satan Tour, and on October 29th they will land at B-K in Stockholm together with special guests Dark Funeral, adding even more darkness to an already strong lineup.

ai.en: Guldgruvan, a small stand-up comedy club in Sofia Common in Stockholm. Entry is free for those who risk not getting in, and a seated place can be bought.

events.description: Guldgruvan är helt gratis om man vågar ta risken att inte komma in eller få en ståplats, då är de bara att dyka upp. Det man köper här är garanterad sittplats. Guldgruvan är den lilla ståuppklubben med de bästa komikerna, som verkligen levererar när det kommer till klassisk och ärlig stand-up comedy. Det mysiga rummet har vid flera tillfällen liknats med Comedy Cellar i New York och är som gjort för standup comedy shower. Klubben grundades av Simon Gärdenfors och Johannes Brenning och drivs idag av Johannes och Leon Jämtin. Här får du uppleva humor i sin mest autentiska form -- inga filter, bara skarpa skämt och råa skratt. Showerna är i källaren på den lokala krogen Sofia Common som rymmer cirka 70 personer, här får du en intim och nära upplevelse, där både komiker och publik är på samma nivå. Det är en plats där man verkligen känner sig som en del av showen om man önskar. Humor här är ofta direkt, lite utanför boxen och ibland på gränsen -- men alltid genuin. Guldgruvan har blivit känd för att ge plats åt alternativa och okonventionella röster inom stand-up, där nya, experimentella skämt ofta får ta plats på scenen. Så om du gillar stand-up där det inte finns några genvägar, där skrattet kommer från det äkta och lite vågade, då är Guldgruvan stället för dig. Här får du uppleva några av Sveriges bästa komiker på en liten scen, där inget ämne känns för stort eller för litet för att skoja om. Vem som uppträder kommer alltid vara hemligt. Om man vill ha något att äta så kom…

ai.en: Zan Cody at Debaser Strand, a reunion after 36 years of two founders of Swedish hard rock.

events.description: After 36 years apart, Zinny Zan and Harry Cody reunite – two of the original creative forces behind Swedish hard rock icons Shotgun Messiah. Performing as Zan/Cody, they present songs from their debut album Beautiful n' Damned, blending classic sleaze, melodic hard rock and fresh energy in an exciting new chapter.

title.en: Post Work - evening open with free admission once a month at the Postal Museum

ai.en: A monthly Thursday evening at the Postmuseum with free admission and an after-work tapas event at restaurant AVI.

events.description: One Thursday evening a month, we keep the museum open with free admission. At restaurant AVI, it's After Work with tapas and delicious drinks - a perfect way to round off the day with colleagues and friends. Sometimes there's also a tour that you can follow. Stay tuned, we'll be updating the program regularly.

ai.en: Guldgruvan Standup Club at Sofia Common, darker and more alternative stand-up comedy.

events.description: Guldgruvan Standup Club hosts stand-up shows focusing on darker, more alternative, and less mainstream stand-up comedy.

title.en: Role-playing games during the autumn break

ai.en: Role-playing games during the autumn break at the City Museum, for gamers and roleplayers.

events.description: Are you a gamer, a nerd, or a gaming enthusiast? Then it’s time to dust off your wands and sharpen your swords, because role-playing is back at the museum! Free admission – just drop by.

ai.en: Horse Power at Cosmonova, a film about the world of horses, following wild herds across landscapes.

events.description: Embark on a journey into the world of horses. Follow wild herds galloping across vast landscapes, meet legendary desert stallions renowned for their speed, and get up close to working horses that remain calm even under great pressure. Meet miniature horses whose presence provides comfort and support to people. Through these encounters, Horse Power reveals the remarkable versatility of horses, from their raw power and speed to their intelligence, courage, and ability to form emotional bonds.

title.en: Peter Hägerås – “Album Covers, Watercolors & Flying Saucers”

ai.en: Album Covers, Watercolors & Flying Saucers, an exhibition by Peter Hägerås at Presentmakeriet, diverse and playful work.

events.description: The exhibition is diverse and playful. Some works have a specific purpose, while others have no purpose other than the fact that Peter wanted to paint them. Music and visual art have constantly been allowed to blend together. In conjunction with the exhibition, Peter is releasing new music, with some of the paintings once again serving as album covers.Vernissage: Thursday, Oct 29.

ai.en: Thursday after-work drinks at The Bishops Arms in Gamla Stan, a way to meet new people.

events.description: Stockholm is a great place to meet new people when we actually take initiative. This is for everyone who wants to make friends with expats and locals! More than 60 people join us in Old Town every other Thursday, a nice mix of regulars and newcomers. If any questions pop up, please reach out on Instagram or meetstockholm.org. You're most welcome to Meet Stockholm 🙌Stockholm is a great place to meet new people when we actually take initiative. This is for everyone who wants to make friends with expats and locals! More than 60 people join us in Old Town every other Thursday, a nice mix of regulars and newcomers. If any questions pop up, please reach out on Instagram or meetstockholm.org. You're most welcome to Meet Stockholm

title.en: Post Work och författarsamtal med Agneta Stark

ai.en: Post Work with author Agneta Stark at the Postmuseum, a conversation with publisher Gunnar Nirstedt about letter-writing and love.

events.description: Publisher Gunnar Nirstedt sits down with Agneta Stark for a conversation about letter-writing, love, and the life between the lines, drawing on the book Nöj dig aldrig, skrev du and the extensive correspondence between her and Sven Lindqvist. After the conversation, we invite you to try your hand at letter-writing in the Library. Take a seat at a table and let their correspondence inspire you. We’ll provide pens and paper. All exhibitions, the gift shop, and the restaurant will be open throughout the evening. Free admission.

ai.en: Stockholm Thursday Mingle, an international social evening for locals, expats and travellers at Den Gröne Jägaren.

events.description: Meet new people in a friendly and relaxed atmosphere. This international social gathering brings together locals, expats, and travelers to connect, share experiences, and make new friends. Enjoy conversations about culture, travel, food, languages, and life in Stockholm. Everyone is welcome. After 9 PM, the evening continues with karaoke for anyone who would like to join.

title.en: SECRET FEMALE SPIES – SHADOWS BEHIND THE CASABLANCA OF THE NORTH

ai.en: A guided tour at the Swedish Spy Museum about female spies and the hidden networks of Stockholm during the Second World War.

events.description: Stockholm was a WWII intelligence hub—but many decisive operations were led by women. This tour continues where The Secret War in Stockholm ends, diving deeper into hidden networks, relationships, and covert roles. Meet some of the women moving between diplomacy, resistance, and espionage—often with multiple identities. Their stories reveal why Stockholm was called “The Casablanca of the North”.

ai.en: Mick Harvey and Amanda Acevedo at Debaser Nova, celebrating a new album this autumn.

events.description: Rock legend Mick Harvey returns to Debaser this autumn, together with Mexican artist Amanda Acevedo – celebrating the release of their joint album Golden Mirrors. In addition to music from the new record, they will perform a selection of songs from their duet album Phantasmagoria in Blue (2023), as well as Harvey’s solo album Five Ways to Say Goodbye (2024).

Kickstart the weekend at Nationalmuseum! On Thursday evenings, the museum is abuzz with people, art and music, with free admission for everyone from 5pm to 8pm. Enjoy an ever-changing programme of afterwork drinks, music, workshops and other activities. Every Thursday from 17:00 to 20:00, 3 September–17 December

Take a seat at the bar and immerse yourself in the flavours, stories, and creativity behind one of Downtown Camper's signature cocktails. Watch as our bartenders bring the drink to life, sharing the techniques and inspiration that make it unique. From the first sip to the final flourish, you'll gain a new appreciation for the art of cocktail making. Join us in The Nest, our cocktail lounge on floor 9, for a relaxed yet unforgettable tasting experience. 18+ age limit.

title.en: Quiz at Il Merlo – Sicilian wine & culture bar

ai.en: A quiz at Il Merlo, a Sicilian wine and culture bar, with Kulturkampen, a culture challenge.

events.description: A special edition of the quiz season kicks off with Kulturkampen – the Culture Challenge. Ten questions cover music, ten literature and ten film. Teams are encouraged to bring members whose strengths complement one another. More quiz dates will be announced soon. Reserve your spot at ilmerlo.se – places fill up fast. Please note: the quiz is in Swedish.

Every Thursday from 21.00-23.00, bar Americain fills with the sound of timeless classics and beloved favourites, performed live by our talented jazz band partners. Inspired by the energy of the 1920s, these evenings are all about great music, good company and a touch of old-school charm. Free admission. No booking required. Seating is limited so come early.

ai.en: Babblarna & Klonks Klapp-kalas, an interactive children's musical at Tibble teater, celebrating Klonk's birthday with the Babblarna.

events.description: Babblarna är tillbaka -- och bjuder in till ett magiskt kalas! Efter mer än 1100 föreställningar är succén större än någonsin. Musikalen "Babblarna & Klonks Klapp-kalas" är en färgsprakande, svängig och interaktiv musikal för de allra yngsta. Idag fyller Klonk år -- och alla Babblarna är på plats för att fira! Det blir tårta, ballonger, fiskdamm, kalashattar och massor av sång, dans och skratt. Barnen får vara med på riktigt -- klappa takten, babbla, bubbla, köra bil och dansa loss tillsammans med sina favoritkaraktärer. Musikalen är kärleksfullt producerad och framförs av skickliga artister med tal, tecken, sång och dans. För många barn blir detta deras allra första kulturupplevelse -- ett minne som stannar kvar hos både barn och vuxna länge. Missa inte årets glädjefyllda kalas med barnens största idoler -- Babblarna! Viktig information! Samtliga i publiken behöver en biljett, oavsett ålder och även de som sitter i knäet. Rekommenderad ålder: 2--5 år (men yngre och äldre barn är självklart välkomna). Perfekt för alla små äventyrare som inte vill sitta still! Lämna barnvagnen hemma eller i bilen. Ta gärna med sittkudde för barnet att sitta på Föreställningens längd är ca 45 min. Arrangör: Mys Artisteri AB

ai.en: Ghosts of Rosegarden by Elina Pirinen at Dansens Hus, an expressive dance tale of a garden of desire and mysticism.

events.description: Ghosts of Rosegarden is an expressive tale of a garden filled with desire, wonder and mysticism. Here, wild beings, a mother and her dead cat, a string quartet and a lovestruck bassoonist come together. Through ritual, humour and physicality, the work explores trauma, love, sacrifice, and the cycles of destruction and creation. Elina Pirinen brings fine art and folk art together in a work where live music and theatre merge.

ai.en: The Fray's Autumn Light tour at B-K. Age limit 18+.

events.description: The Fray is coming to Stockholm with their Autumn Light Tour. The concert takes place at B-K, a new and large cultural and events venue in Frihamnen.

ai.en: Mårten Cvetkovic 2, a follow-up stand-up show at Nya Cirkus in Stockholm, after the earlier show, which was seen by over 40,000 Swedes.

events.description: Mårten Cvetkovic 2 är uppföljaren till jättesuccén Mårten Cvetkovic som sågs av över 40 000 svenskar, köptes av SVT och också vann pris för "Årets föreställning" på Svenska Standup-galan (2024) i konkurrens med Henrik Schyffert, Måns Möller och Petrina Solange. I Mårten Cvetkovic kretsade mycket av humorn kring kulturkrockarna mellan Balkan och svensk mentalitet. I den helt nya showen tar Mårten Andersson ett ännu större grepp och belyser nu kulturkrockarna mellan oss svenskar och alla andra nationaliteter i vårt land. Den här gången går ingen säker; oavsett om du är en fyrkantig helsvensk, en självsäker grek, en snusande somalier, en galning från Balkan eller en högljudd, fågelfröätandes arab. Mårten Cvetkovic 2 är en varm hyllning till våra olikheter som människor och där vår svenska Jantelag får sig ett gäng rejäla smällar. Gillade du Mårten Cvetkovic får du absolut inte missa denna hysteriskt roliga uppföljare! Sverigepremiär 24 september, 2026. Arrangör: Bokalive Sweden AB Längd: ca 90 minuter, ingen paus Åldersgräns: 13 år i målsmans sällskap Rullstolsplats bokas via info@cirkus.se

Paraknas performs favourites by blink-182, My Chemical Romance, Linkin Park and more, with a prize for the best costume. ai.en: Pimp Your Pumpkin at Siggesta Gård, a pumpkin-decorating session led by the nature guide Lina.

events.description: Nature guide Lina has a deep love for the great outdoors. She spends much of her time exploring forests, fields and the sea, often together with animals. Lina believes almost anything can be created using materials found in nature, which is why she hosts craft days, hikes and outdoor activities for guests during the school holidays. During the autumn break, children and adults are invited to join Lina for a forest walk, autumn crafts with pumpkins and grilled sausages.

ai.en: The Lady in Black at Ormteatern, a Gothic horror play about revenge, love and grief set in the mid-19th century.

events.description: The play is a Gothic horror production and a story of revenge, love, and grief. The story is set in the mid-19th century. The story follows a young lawyer Arthur Falk who travels north to settle a will from an estate. Once at the house, he notices he is not alone; someone else is there—a lady in black. Are these experiences hallucinations, or are they reality? By Stephen Mallatratt, based on a book by Susan Hill. Directed by Susanna Forsberg. From 13 years.

ai.en: Djuphav, a dance and music performance for children aged 4 to 8 at Dansens Hus Studioscen, about a journey to the depths of the sea.

events.description: Följ med på en fantasifull dans-musikalisk resa ner i havets djup. Slå dig ner på en tångruska. Se en manet glida förbi. Rörelse, musik och nyfikenhet leder vägen. Djuphav är en föreställning fylld av äventyr, akustisk musik och rörelse för barn mellan 4-8 år samt anpassad förskola. Runt omkring oss vaknar havets värld till liv. Dyk ner i djuphavet eller slå dig ner på en tångruska och gunga sakta. Besynnerliga och vackra havsdjur simmar förbi, flyter nära. Kanske möter vi en manet, en korall eller något vi aldrig sett förut. Tillsammans undersöker vi hur det känns att röra sig i havet. Hur låter det? Hur förändras kroppen? Vad händer när vi möter något som är nytt, spännande och kanske lite läskigt? Djuphav är den tredje delen i en triptyk som inleddes med "Öar" och "Broar", men den kan självklart ses helt fristående. Föreställningslängd: 40--50 min. Ingrid Olterman Dans har sedan 1999 skapat dansföreställningar och konstnärliga projekt för barn och unga, med fokus på förskola, skola, anpassad grundskola, gymnasium och personer med funktionsvariationer. Genom samarbeten med musiker, scenografer, bildkonstnärer och andra kreatörer blir projekten både berörande och lockande, med dans, musik och rörelse i centrum. Med bas i Stockholm når föreställningarna publik i hela Sverige och internationellt.

ai.en: An industrial walking tour of Kungsholmen, from porcelain factories onwards, starting at the Ukraine Freedom memorial stone.

events.description: You are invited to explore former industrial areas and discover its fascinating history. From porcelain factories to foundries and textile manufacturing, hear the stories of the different industries and see pictures of what the area looked like in the past. We gather at the memorial stone, Fria Ukrainas plats (Mariebergsparken), where your guide will take you through the history of the area, including military activity and ammunitions factories. We discover the Karlsvik industry and much more.

ai.en: Dirty Three at Debaser Strand, returning to Europe with new music from Love Changes Everything.

The Australian trio – Warren Ellis (violin), Mick Turner (guitar) and Jim White (drums) – are known for their intense and emotional instrumental performances. Blending their distinct styles, they create a unique and dynamic sound and a powerful, immersive live experience.

ai.en: Midnight Games at Activate Heron City on 31 October, with the venue open until midnight and decorated for Halloween.

Visitors are encouraged to come in costume, play late and compete for the best costume of the night. The best costume wins a 1,000 SEK gift card. ai.en: Backlura at Kafé Källtorp, one of the most colourful and innovative collectives in Swedish jazz and improvisation.

events.description: Backlura is one of the most colorful and innovative collectives on the Swedish jazz and improvisation scene in recent years. ai.en: Deep Sea, an English-language version of Djuphav at Dansens Hus, a dance and music performance for children aged 4 to 8.

events.description: Deep Sea is a performance filled with adventure, acoustic music and movement for children aged 4–8 and children in special education. The underwater world comes alive around us. Together, we explore how it feels to move through the sea, how it sounds, and what happens when we meet something new, exciting and perhaps a little scary.

events.description: Engelbrekt Vocalis Musiker ur Sveriges Radios symfoniorkester Karin Ingebäck sopran Martina Dike alt Joel Annmo tenor John Erik Eleby bas Joakim Elevant dirigent Mytomspunnet är bara förnamnet när man talar om Mozarts odödliga Requiem. Beställningen lär ha varit anonym och Mozart hann dö innan fullbordan. Filmen >>Amadeus<< ger en kreativ och in- novativ skildring av händelseförloppet, det finns även mycket litteratur i ämnet. Musiken går från mörker till ljus: en strimma hopp i elände och kaos. Insläppstid: 16:30 Längd: 1 timme och 15 minuter

ai.en: PRESIDENT at Slaktkyrkan, a band formed in 2025 whose minimalist and anonymous style has grown fast.

events.description: Since their inception in 2025, PRESIDENT has built a rapidly growing audience through their minimalist and anonymous expression. With millions of streams and a sound that moves between metal, electronic and experimental influences, the group has become one of the most talked about new names on the alternative scene.

ai.en: A creative evening at Hornstulls Bodega, a wine bar on Södermalm.

events.description: Join a creative evening at Hornstulls Bodega, one of Stockholm’s go-to spots for wine lovers. Expect a cosy, intimate atmosphere where you can unwind and create something with your own hands. Our creative menu offers activities for everyone, from complete beginners to seasoned creatives. Whether you feel like painting, working with clay, or simply getting into the creative spirit with a glass of wine, there’s something for you.

title.en: Car boot sale at Liljeholmstorget galleria

ai.en: The car boot sale at Liljeholmstorget galleria, a vintage and flea market open for over ten years.

events.description: Welcome to this underground vintage and flea market heaven! For over 10 years this has been Stockholm's most popular winter car boot sale, in the parking garage of Liljeholmstorget galleria. Here you'll find everything from vintage and antiques to children's clothes and sport gadgets - all sorts of things the Stockholmers have cleaned out of their attics and basements. Twice a month (always on a Sunday) you'll find the car boot sale at floor 2 in the parking garage. Very welcome!

events.description: Käärijä, the Finnish supernova and favorite who has taken Europe by storm, returns to Sweden! Berns in Stockholm will be transformed into an explosive dance floor. Now it's Stockholm's turn. Käärijä is known for his raw energy, genre-blending bangers and total showmanship. .

ai.en: Will Hoge at Debaser Nova in November, American blue-collar rock.

events.description: Will Hoge brings his American blue-collar rock to Debaser this November, backed by more than two decades of songwriting and touring, and fifteen studio albums. Blending gritty electric guitars, melodic hooks, Southern soul and Americana, the Nashville artist has built a loyal following and drawn comparisons to both Bob Seger and John Mellencamp.

events.description: EvaLotta walks you through how to knit a simple teddy bear or rabbit. For those with some prior knowledge who know the basics of knitting. A warm welcome to a cozy time together!

ai.en: A historical walking tour of western Kungsholmen, from rural to urban history.

events.description: Join us on a unique historical walk tour on western Kungsholmen! Here you are invited on a fascinating journey from rural idyll to the industrial environment of the metropolis. The walk takes you through areas where military, "malmgårdar" (summer residence for nobility), hospitals, tobacco plantations, schools, a villa town, garden allotments, and industries, including breweries, asphalt and concrete industries, have shaped the town's development. Don't miss the chance to discover the area.

ai.en: An industrial walking tour of western Södermalm, starting at Hornsbruksgatan 19.

events.description: Join us on a fascinating walk through western part of Södermalm's industrial history! During the tour we will visit old industrial areas where manufactures and industries dominated from the 18th century to the first half of the 20th century. We will tell you about the factories and industrial environments that shaped the area's history and culture. The start takes place at a former shoe factory, once the largest in Stockholm, to continue the story of the area's proud shipbuilding and much more.

title.en: Livepodd! NYA INSIKTER - HÄLSOREVOLUTIONEN MED VÄNNER

ai.en: A live podcast evening with Hälsorevolutionen at Rival in Stockholm, with guests and new insights into international health research.

events.description: Livepodd! Efter sex år som en av Sveriges mest populära hälsopoddar bjuder Hälsorevolutionen in till en holistisk helkväll där du möter spännande gäster och får med dig en rad nya insikter. Hälsorevolutionen delar varje vecka med sig av det senaste inom den internationella hälsoforskningen, speglat i gamla beprövade hälsotraditioner. Personliga samtal, mycket skratt, kunskap och inspiration. Podden görs av Maria Borelius, vetenskapsjournalist, biolog och bästsäljande hälsoförfattare tillsammans med Carina Nunstedt, hyllad författare, producent och förläggare. Under kvällen bjuder Maria och Carina på sina personliga resor och berättar hur de har manifesterat stora livsförändringar. Carina är aktuell med romanserien Rivieradrömmar som utspelar sig i Nice, där hon hittade ljuset igen efter att hon förlorade sin man. Maria bor numera på en olivgård i Italien och är aktuell med Hälsorevolutionen: Nya Insikter -- uppföljaren till succéboken Hälsorevolutionen -- som vi passar på att fira denna kväll. Under kvällen får också Maria och Carina sällskap av tre spännande gäster! Maria Strömme, professor i nanoteknologi och en av Sveriges mest uppmärksammade forskare, delar med sig av sitt intresse för longevity och hur vi kan leva längre och friskare. Emma Wiklund, tidigare supermodell och framgångsrik hudvårdsentreprenör, berättar om sina bästa hälsorutiner och hur vi tar hand om huden genom livet. Henrik Wiman, legitimerad psykolog, författare och en av Sveriges största…

ai.en: The Witcher in Concert at Annexet, back in Europe in 2026 after a sold-out Stockholm show.

events.description: Due to overwhelming demand — including a sold-out show in Stockholm — The Witcher in Concert returns to Europe in 2026. On 2 November, the production will make its only stop in Sweden, taking place at Annexet in Stockholm.

ai.en: Alice i Underlandet, a circus and dance show based on Alice in Wonderland, returning to the stage after a 2024 tour seen by over 20,000 people.

events.description: Alice i Underlandet: Den legendariska cirkusshowen är tillbaka! Gör dig redo för ett oförglömligt familjeäventyr -- Alice i Underlandet dans- och cirkusshow är tillbaka på scenen! Efter den stora framgången med 2024 års turné, som sågs av över 20 000 begeistrade åskådare, lovar denna nya version ännu mer spänning, skönhet och ren glädje. Publiken från det senaste skandinaviska turnén kunde inte sluta prata om upplevelsen: "Helt fantastiskt!!" "Wow!" "En fantastisk föreställning och vilken akrobatik, i en färgprakt -- en upplevelse!" "Skickligt, vackert. Vissa nummer helt extraordinära! Andra akten var extra bra och även rolig." "Grymt duktiga och himla snygg show!" Med en imponerande ensemble på 30 artister -- inklusive några av Europas främsta cirkusartister -- är detta inte bara en berättelse du tittar på, utan en magisk värld som du och dina barn får kliva rakt in i. Alice i Underlandet är en färgstark, modern cirkusföreställning där dans, akrobatik och teater förenas i en spektakulär upplevelse. Scenen sprakar av energi, skicklighet och ögonblick som tar andan ur dig. Du kan få se akrobater som svävar högt ovanför scenen, otroliga balansnummer, jonglörer som trotsar tyngdlagen och dynamiska dansscener fulla av rytm och färg. Varje nummer är unikt -- noggrant koreograferat, vackert ljussatt och fyllt av känslor. Det här är den sortens föreställning som fängslar barn och låter vuxna återuppleva samma barnsliga förundran. Föreställningen drivs av högteknologisk multimedia…

title.en: Brev till mitt barn: Sånger byggda på judiska och persiska texter

ai.en: Brev till mitt barn, a concert of songs built on Jewish and Persian texts, with mezzo-soprano Annastina Malm, guitarist David Härenstam and a string ensemble, at Riddarhuset in Stockholm.

events.description: Brev till mitt barn - Sånger byggda på judiska och persiska texter! Mezzosopranen Annastina Malm, gitarristen David Härenstam och stråkensemble spelar judisk, persisk och spansk kammarmusik! Benjamin Staerns verk Brev till mitt barn, för stråkkvartett och sång, bygger på Ilse Webers gripande dikter skrivna i koncentrationslägret Theresienstadt. Musikens fem satser rör sig mellan skörhet och dramatik genom att fläta samman klezmer med klassisk modernism. Verket skildrar Webers tragiska öde och pendlar intensivt mellan förtvivlan, längtan och ömsinthet. Konserten bjuder dessutom på två uruppföranden: *Benjamin Staern: Ett nytt verk baserat på persiska texter översatt till Svenska. *Dan Theorin: Stycket A busstop in Vasco da Gama för stråkkvartett och gitarr har influenser av indisk folkmusik. Musiken reflekterar kring tolken Gaspar da Gama, en judisk tolk och upptäcktsresande som tvingades konvertera till kristendom under förföljelse. Han var ovärderlig för de portugisiska upptäcktsresorna, rådgivare till Portugals kung och en viktig mellanhand mellan Portugal och Asien men är idag i stort sätt bortglömd. Ni kommer också att få höra musik underbara tonsättaren Erwin Schulhoff. Det dröjde mer än 50 år efter sin död i koncentrationslägret Wülzburg innan den tjeckiske tonsättaren började få det erkännande han förtjänade. Han var en av många kompositörer vars verk av nazistregimen stämplades som Entartete Musik, och han tystades effektivt av fascismens hårda politiska och sociala…

title.en: Stephen Wilson Jr. - Gary The Torch Tour

ai.en: Stephen Wilson Jr.'s Gary the Torch tour at Fållan, a rising American country artist nominated for a CMA award.

events.description: Stephen Wilson Jr. is a rising American country artist recently nominated for a CMA Award for New Artist of the Year. Known for his heartfelt and engaging music, including award-winning songs like 'Gary' and 'Cuckoo', his 'Gary The Torch Tour' offers an energetic and personal concert experience.

ai.en: Benjamin Steer at Debaser Nova, a rising singer-songwriter in modern pop.

events.description: Benjamin Steer is one of the fastest-rising names in modern singer-songwriter pop. Blending heartfelt lyrics about love, identity and the uncertainty of young adulthood with memorable melodies, he has built a rapidly growing international audience. Following support tours with artists including Myles Smith, he now brings his intimate live show to Stockholm.

The award-winning French author will be a guest at International Writers' Stage November 4 for a conversation about "Au grand jamais" her first novel to be published in Swedish. A story that explores motherhood, memory, and the narratives that shape our lives.

title.en: David Binney Action Trio ft. Louis Cole & Peta Krstajic

ai.en: The David Binney Action Trio with Louis Cole and Peta Krstajic at Debaser Strand, a high-energy jazz ensemble.

events.description: David Binney Action Trio is a high-energy jazz ensemble led by alto saxophonist David Binney – one of the most prolific and distinctive voices in contemporary jazz, with over 30 albums under his own name and appearances on more than 400 recordings. Despite his long and influential career, David Binney has never before performed in Sweden. For this special evening, he is joined by Grammy Award-winning drummer Louis Cole and bassist Pera Krstajic.

title.en: Improv comedy show with Lilla improteatern STHLM

ai.en: An improv comedy show in Swedish with Lilla improteatern STHLM at Gamestreet 1, built from an audience word.

events.description: Improvised sketches in Swedish. It starts with a word from the audience and can end anywhere: in a disastrous staff meeting, a charged family dinner or a date that goes to hell.Fast, smart, stupid, human or completely unreasonable – preferably at the same time. The ensemble comes up with sketches on the spot based on suggestions from the audience. No script, no ready-made scenes, no reruns. What happens on stage only happens once.Limited number of places, first come, first served. You stay in your seat. We never bring anyone on stage.Food and drinks are available from 5:00 PM. Show approx. 7:00 PM–8:30 PM. Afterwards, the evening continues with a bar, games and hanging out at Gamestreet 1.

ai.en: Frida Mirage at Haymarket by Scandic, an indie-pop-rock-jazz performer based in Stockholm.

events.description: Frida Mirage is an indie-pop-rock-jazz showgirl based in Stockholm. With one foot planted in unrealistic notions of life, love, and dreams, and the other in the inevitable crash that follows, Frida, who often goes from one hundred to zero in a heartbeat, is constantly searching for balance somewhere in between. On 4 November, Frida Mirage takes to the stage at Haymarket. Come for the music, stay for the drama.

ai.en: Elvis, Elvis, Elvis!, a tribute concert at Cirkus with three performers, one of Europe's largest Elvis tributes.

events.description: Cirkus proudly presents one of Europe's largest tribute concerts - to the immortal music icon Elvis Presley - with three of the world's foremost interpreters, in the new magical performance, Elvis, Elvis Elvis!

ai.en: Goran Bregović performs at Filadelfia Convention Center in Stockholm on 5 November 2026, with ethno-pop-rock, gypsy rhythms and well-known anthems.

events.description: On 5 November 2026, the maestro of the Balkans will perform in Filadelfia Convention Center, Stockholm with his intoxicating blend of ethno-pop-rock, gypsy rhythms, and heart-warming anthems. Following two sold-out London shows in recent years, Goran Bregovi? will perform an unforgettable night alongside the legendary Wedding & Funeral Orchestra. Celebrated for global hits like "Kalashnikov," "In the Death Car," and "Bella Ciao," Bregovi?'s music bridges cultures and transcends boundaries --- delivering performances that are both mesmerizing and deeply evocative.

ai.en: An author talk with Hemley Boum at Kulturhuset Stadsteatern on 5 November, in conversation with Harald Hultqvist.

events.description: Join Hemley Boum in conversation with Harald Hultqvist at International Writers' Stage November 5. The award-winning Cameroonian author, acclaimed for her depictions of family and history, is currently in the spotlight with "The Fisherman's Dream"—an epic novel about roots, loss, and reconciliation.

title.en: The Garage - Improv Comedy Club (in English)

events.description: Join us for an evening of improvised comedy – all in English. Every other Thursday, International Theater Stockholm hosts The Garage Improv Comedy Club at The Liffey in Gamla Stan. Expect a warm, lively atmosphere filled with laughter and good vibes. Each night features a mix of improv performances and styles – all created in the moment. And don't worry – you'll get to enjoy the show from your seat. No audience members will be brought up on stage.

title.en: Book Talk: The Jewish History of Norrköping

ai.en: A book talk on the Jewish history of Norrköping, one of three Swedish cities where Jews could settle after 1782.

events.description: Under the 1782 Judereglementet, Norrköping became one of three Swedish cities where Jews were permitted to settle. A vibrant community soon emerged, complete with its own synagogue and cemetery. Author Kjell Örtoft visits the Jewish Museum for a talk with Natalie Bloch on his new book, Norrköping’s Jewish History. Together, they explore personal stories and what the city’s heritage reveals about the Swedish-Jewish experience from the 18th century to the present.

ai.en: Vinyl Night with Hot Records at The Bishops Arms in Sundbyberg, one of four vinyl nights in the autumn. The next dates are 5 November and 3 December. Entry is free.

events.description: This autumn, Hot Records is taking over The Bishops Arms in Sundbyberg to host the town's most analog house party! Hot Records is launching a series of four vinyl nights: Sept 3, Oct 1, Nov 5, and Dec 3. In collab with: LoveDeluxe Entertainment. Free admission.

ai.en: Hardcore Superstar's Dirty Halo Tour, one of the band's largest Scandinavian tours in years, at Börsen in Stockholm.

events.description: After another explosive year with live performances Sweden's street metal kings Hardcore Superstar return with the "Dirty Halo" Tour – one of their largest Scandinavian tours in years. "We're really looking forward to being back on the road again, this tour is going to be something very special".

ai.en: Tu madre / Din mamma, a play rooted in Spain's history with parallels to today, asking what parents owe their children, at aliasTEATERN in Stockholm.

events.description: What do we owe our children? What do our children owe us? What are we willing to sacrifice for what we believe in? Tu madre / Din mamma is a play rooted in Spain's history, but with clear parallels to our own time. It is a story about how history repeats itself - and how it can be broken. The play moves between past and present: between a Spain shaped by dictatorship, resistance and silence, and a Europe in transformation. The performance is in Swedish, with elements of Spanish.

title.en: Meet the Artists behind the exhibition Embraced

ai.en: Guided viewings with the artists behind the Embraced exhibition at Kulturhuset Stadsteatern.

events.description: Kulturhuset Stadsteatern invites you to a series of guided viewings that offer a closer encounter with the art and artists featured in the exhibition Embraced. On three evenings, you will meet one of the exhibition’s artists in a personal conversation about their work, creative process, and the ideas that shape the pieces on display. Each evening concludes with a hands-on workshop, where participants have the opportunity to explore materials and methods connected to the artist’s practice.

title.en: Talk: Södra Hagalund - The District of the Future

ai.en: A talk on Södra Hagalund, the future district, at the Spårvägsmuseet, with a metro station planned 45 metres underground.

events.description: Where today there is a busy road, in a few years there will be a square, housing and a metro station 45 meters underground. Emelie Grind and Alexander Fagerlund from the City of Solna describe how Södra Hagalund is emerging as an entirely new district as the metro is extended to Arenastaden. They bring you behind the visualizations: how a city is planned around a metro station before it even exists. Talk, 1 hour. At Spårvägsmuseet, tickets required.

ai.en: Parken EMO, an emo night every other Thursday at Parken Söder, with DJs or karaoke.

events.description: Welcome to Parken EMO – your living room away from home. Every other Thursday, Stockholm’s emos get together for DJs or karaoke featuring emo, pop-punk, metalcore and everything your eyeliner-covered heart desires. Feel what you feel and sing along when you know the words.

ai.en: Third Place Salon: Show and Tell at ThirdPlace ArtCafé and SoberBar, a Thursday evening for sharing objects and their stories.

events.description: Third Place Salon: Show & Tell is a Thursday night for sharing things and the stories behind them. Bring something you’ve made, written, painted, photographed, built, found, collected or are still working on, and show it however you like. No need to be an artist, and no need for it to be finished.Want to present? Contact Third Place beforehand to join the line-up. Or just come for a drink, discover what others are making and meet some new people.

ai.en: EsDeeKid's Council House Rat tour at Fållan, the masked Liverpool rapper's first Swedish show.

events.description: For the first time, masked Liverpool rapper EsDeeKid is coming to Sweden. With dark synths, bass-heavy production and a distinctive flow, he has taken his raw Scouse rap from the UK underground to a rapidly growing global audience. Tracks such as “Phantom”, “4 Raws”, “LV Sandals” and “REBEL” set the tone for an intense Swedish debut driven by heavy bass and raw energy.

ai.en: An evening of letter writing at the Postmuseum, where you write Christmas greetings to surprise someone.

events.description: Who would you like to surprise with a Christmas greeting this year? Welcome to an evening of letter writing where you craft Christmas greetings to friends far away, the neighbor, or the relative you’ve never met. The Postal Museum sets the table with paper and pens.

ai.en: Labero's Magic World, a close-up magic show by Joe Labero at La Botanica in Westfield Mall of Scandinavia.

events.description: Upplev Labero's Magic World på La Botanica i Westfield Mall of Scandinavia - en exklusiv magisk föreställning som väver samman illusioner med en touch av mystik. Träd in i en värld av "boutique magic" där varje akt är noga utformad för att ge en personlig och nära upplevelse. Joe Labero, en mästare inom magins konst med över tre årtionden av globala turnéer, skapar en magisk atmosfär som sträcker sig bortom det förväntade. Föreställningen innefattar inte bara imponerande illusioner utan erbjuder också en gastronomisk upplevelse utöver det vanliga. Vid Sveriges största buffé på La Botanica möts du av kulinariska läckerheter från hela världen och ett imponerande urval av omsorgsfullt hembakade bakverk. Välkommen till Labero's Magic World där varje ögonblick är en unik och oförglömlig del av en exklusiv magisk resa. title.en: Isaac And The Soul Machine - A Tribute To Tom Jones

ai.en: Isaac and the Soul Machine's 60-minute tribute to Tom Jones, covering hits such as It's Not Unusual and Delilah, at Rival in Stockholm.

events.description: Under 60 intensiva minuter tar Isaac And The Soul Machine med publiken på en musikalisk resa genom Tom Jones fantastiska karriär. Men det här är mer än en tributekonsert. Mellan låtar som bland andra It's Not Unusual, Delilah, She´s A Lady och Sex Bomb berättas historien om pojken från Wales som blev en av världens största entertainers, om vänskapen med Elvis Presley, Las Vegas-åren och de osannolika framgångarna som gjort Tom Jones till en av populärmusikens mest älskade röster. Njut av och upplev en kväll fylld av Ikoniska låtar, berättelserna bakom musiken, mat, dryck, gemenskap, humor och soul. Perfekt för en dejtkväll, en kväll med vänner eller som starten på en längre kväll i Stockholm. Välkommen till Soul Sessions. Handikapplatser: Bokas via Ticketmasters callcenter på 0771-707070 alternativt via Ticketmasters tillgänglighetslinje 0776-707777. En ledsagare ingår fritt.

ai.en: Lia Rodrigues' Borda at Dansens Hus in Stockholm, a dance work with nine dancers exploring the fluid nature of borders.

events.description: Lia Rodrigues är tillbaka på Dansens Hus. Nu med föreställningen Borda! Borda är en undersökning av gränsernas flytande natur: geografiska, politiska, sociala och personliga. Om att gränser lever eftersom människan skapar dem och därför kan förändras. Nio dansare står på scen, insvepta/dolda bland tyger, plast och återvunnet material som skapar skulpturer från tidigare verk; rester av berättelser får nytt liv. Tålmodigt och mödosamt vävs en porös plats av flytande olikhet där gränserna flyter och förskjuts. Borda (2024) är den sista delen i en trilogi som inleddes med Fúria (2018) och fortsatte med Encantado (2021). Borda är skapat i Centro de Artes da Maré, Rio de Janeiro, Brasilien av Lia Rodrigues och Companhia de Danças. Senast sågs hon på vår c/o-scen Elverket med Encantado 2023. Längd: 70 minuter Stora scen: Kl.19.00

ai.en: Soweto Gospel Choir's new production JOY. (Injabulo) at Nya Cirkus in Stockholm, the choir's 2026 return to Sweden.

events.description: Internationellt hyllade Soweto Gospel Choir återvänder till Sverige 2026 med en helt ny produktion -- JOY!, som på Zulu heter Injabulo. Kören är baserad i sydafrikanska Soweto, ett område strax utanför Johannesburg och hemvist för både Nelson Mandela och landets demokratiska frihetsrörelse, men har gjort sig ett namn över hela världen. Efter över 20 år på världsscenen fortsätter de att inspirera publiken med konserter som överskrider språkliga, kulturella och musikaliska gränser. I JOY! tar man tillvara på Sydafrikas rika musiktradition. Här kombineras traditionell afrikansk gospel och spirituals med frihetssånger och moderna klassiker. Konserten hyllar glädje, gemenskap och musikens förmåga att förena oss -- särskilt i osäkra tider. Med storslagna sångprestationer, färgstark kostym, medryckande rytmer och ett särskilt kraftfullt sätt att förmedla känslor skapar kören en lika upplyftande som berörande konsertupplevelse. Som flerfaldiga Grammy Award-vinnare har Soweto Gospel Choir uppträtt på världens mest prestigefyllda scener och samarbetat med artister som Aretha Franklin, Stevie Wonder, Peter Gabriel och U2. JOY! är en påminnelse om medmänsklighet och hur högt vi kan nå när vi höjer våra röster -- tillsammans. Låt körens smittande energi lysa upp din vardag, och gör dig redo för en färgsprakande konsert i glädjens tecken! Arrangör: Soweto Gospel Choir i samarbete med Julius Production & Andrew Kay Åldersgräns: 5 år Konserttid: ca 2 h inkl paus Rullstolsplats bokas via…

ai.en: Nemzzz, a Manchester artist from one of the city's most deprived areas, in concert.

events.description: Nemzzz comes from one of Manchester's most socio-economically disadvantaged areas and is quick to stand out through his lyrics and unique musical expression. He is introverted by nature and likes to keep his thoughts to himself, but through his music he has established himself as one of the most prominent figures in the new wave. On September 4th he releases his new album LOCKED IN, which will be followed up in the fall with a tour of the same name.

ai.en: Sthlm Food and Wine 2026 at Stockholmsmässan, with wine and food tastings, chefs, champagne and pastries.

events.description: Sthlm Food & Wine offers wine and food tastings, inspiration from famous chefs, champagne, delicious pastries and chocolates, tasty street food, beer, distillates and plenty of shopping opportunities.

ai.en: Tobias Sten, a Norwegian artist, presents his second album Heimakjær at Debaser Strand in Stockholm in November.

events.description: Norwegian rising star Tobias Sten has quickly established himself as one of Norway’s most talked-about artists and as a powerful new voice on the Nordic country scene. Now, the next chapter begins as Tobias releases his second album, Heimakjær. This November, it’s finally Debaser’s turn to experience Tobias live together with his band.

ai.en: The Beat from Palookaville at Debaser Nova, one of Europe's most authentic R&B and ska bands.

events.description: The Beat from Palookaville — one of Europe’s most authentic R&B and ska bands, and also a phenomenal all-round backing band for other artists. Guitar virtuoso Anders Lewén (Sven Zetterberg Bluesband, Knockout Greg & Blueweather) formed this unique act 18 years ago, and in many circles it is regarded as one of Sweden’s best live bands.

events.description: Hammarby host Elfsborg at 3Arena on Matchday 28 of Allsvenskan, the highest level of the Swedish association football league system.

ai.en: UNPLUGGED with juggler Johan Wellton at Haninge kulturhus, a show that has toured widely.

events.description: Juggler and world-class entertainer Johan Wellton comes to Haninge with his show UNPLUGGED, a show that has toured more than 40 countries for more than 20 years. Get ready to experience world-class juggling and a mind blowing show! The show is part of the circus festival CIRKUSISTAN.

title.en: Consert & danceevening at Folk music house!

ai.en: A folk concert and dance evening at Skeppsholmens folkhögskola with Sôm fôlk, folk music rooted in Dalarna and Ångermanland.

events.description: Come and listen and dance to; Sôm fôlk – folkmusic with roots in Dalarna and Ångermanland. The group brings together five acclaimed swedish folkmusicians united by their passion for Sweden’s rich folkmusictradition. Together, they carry a wealth of tunes, folksongs and dancemusic. Beautiful, delicate and festive – but above all, super groovy!

title.en: Best of Stockholm comedy club at Gamestreet 1

ai.en: The best of Stockholm Comedy Club at Gamestreet 1, stand-up comedy combined with live music.

events.description: Stockholm Comedy Club – Sweden’s only stand-up club that always combines comedy with live music! Stockholm Comedy Club was founded 25 years ago, and many well-known comedians have taken their first steps on stage right here. See performers such as Janne Westerlund, John “Shazaam” Landenfelt, Sofie Young and Andy Callahan, alongside special guests and friends. Enjoy two action-packed hours of laughter, combining stand-up comedy and music for a unique night of entertainment. Lineup on social media.

ai.en: 30 Dagar Kvar at Zätateatern, a new musical about a young girl who wants to put on a concert in 30 days.

events.description: 30 Dagar Kvar is a new original musical about a young girl with one goal: to put on a concert in just 30 days and use it to spread a message she believes the world needs to hear. Along the way, she brings together a group of young people, each with their own stories, struggles and dreams. Through powerful music and an emotional story, the musical explores injustice, hope, courage and what can happen when young people refuse to stay silent.

ai.en: Stockholm Gallery Weekend, a mid-November weekend when 35 participating galleries open across the city.

events.description: SGW invites you to explore Stockholm’s vibrant contemporary art scene. During a weekend in mid November, the 35 participating galleries will open their doors to introduce you to a large variety of exhibitions with both established and emerging artists.

ai.en: Lost Action and Worlds End Inside, an evening of two dance works by Julia Kraus and Linn Ragnarsson at Kulturhuset Stadsteatern in Stockholm.

events.description: Lost Action & Worlds End Inside is a shared evening of dance by choreographers Julia Kraus and Linn Ragnarsson. Two works exploring presence and absence, body and language, desire and longing – and what happens when the invisible becomes visible. Dance, movement and poetic elements meet as new logics emerge. Re-premiere 6 November at Fri Scen, Kulturhuset Stadsteatern.

ai.en: Nisse Hallberg's stand-up show 8 år senare at Nya Cirkus in Stockholm, with humour about life's setbacks.

events.description: Nisse Hallberg har varit sjuk, trött, ensam tomte på julafton och dessutom bränt ner hus med Betnér. Inget fel med dom ämnena. Men vi är klara med det där grävandet nu va? Den enda han vill är ju att ni skall ha kul. Och om det finns en Hallberg i det här landet som vet hur man får folk att skratta så är det fanimej han. Det har nu gått åtta år sen Nisse gjorde en soloturné och en massa saker har skett sen sist. Han har helt enkelt fått återskapa sig själv flera gånger om. Vi pratar covid, terapi, separationer, ny kärlek, sjukhusbesök, krogbesök, IVF-behandlingar, mer terapi, familjebildande och sen ännu mer terapi. Åtta år går fort, men nu är Nisse Hallberg är tillbaka! Och på den plats där han gör mest nytta och dessutom med en stand up-show som är tajtare än ett fasanarsle. Om det finns storys kvar att berätta? Det kan du ge dig fan på. Välkommen till 8 år senare med Nisse Hallberg. ai.en: Icona Pop's Nordic tour at Berns, the Stockholm duo returning to their hometown.

events.description: Stockholm’s own Icona Pop – Caroline Hjelt and Aino Jawo – return to their hometown with their Nordic tour to celebrate their upcoming album RITUAL, set for release in August. The concert at Berns will be one of the tour’s highlights, where the duo will serve up their signature blend of explosive club sounds, deeper lyrics about friendship, motherhood, and self-discovery – and, of course, the energy that has made them one of Sweden’s biggest pop exports.

ai.en: Beth Hart at B-K, a singer and songwriter known for her powerful voice, blending blues and rock.

events.description: Beth Hart is an American singer, songwriter, and musician renowned for her powerful and expressive voice. She blends blues, rock, and soul in her music and has been acclaimed for her emotionally charged live performances. Hart has collaborated with artists like Joe Bonamassa and Slash, and her music ranges from raw blues-rock to more sophisticated compositions.

ai.en: Bybit Stockholm Open 2026 at The Royal Tennis Hall, a tennis tournament founded in 1969 at the initiative of Sven Davidson.

events.description: Stockholm Open was founded in 1969 at the initiative of former world player Sven Davidson. Over a week in October, around 30,000 visitors flock to the Royal Tennis Hall, and the event is made possible by more than 350 volunteers. The tournament is the world’s oldest indoor ATP event and the only one played in an indoor arena specifically built for tennis. Global stars such as Björn Borg, John McEnroe, Roger Federer, Boris Becker, Mats Wilander, and Stefan Edberg have all won the tournament.

ai.en: Tobbe Ström's stand-up show at Bacchi Syre, from a favourite of Sweden's comedy stages.

events.description: Tobbe Ström is a seasoned comedian and a favorite on Sweden's stand-up stages. With humor characterized by self-deprecation, relatability, and sharp observations of everyday absurdities, he explores forbidden thoughts and the things we usually keep to ourselves in this show. With a fundamentally positive outlook, he dissects relationships, societal norms, and the small irritations that make us wonder: can you actually say that?

ai.en: Bombastic Ski Arena 2026 at Börsen, a winter sports expo with Swedish and international ski destinations.

events.description: A major winter sports expo. Meet Swedish and international destinations, representatives from alpine skiing, cross-country skiing, ski touring, and telemark, as well as suppliers of skis, boots and other products, local clubs and organizations. You’ll also have the opportunity to meet some of skiing’s most prominent personalities on stage. Evening après-ski event featuring several live bands and DJ. Feel free to dress for the occasion! events.description: Welcome to a concert celebrating love, longing and hope. Under the direction of Jan Risberg, Täby Toner presents a varied programme of choral music to inspire and touch the heart. Täby Toner will perform heartwarming songs by both well-known and lesser-known composers from different periods, ranging from the 13th century to the present day. The composers featured include Evert Taube, Monika Dominique, Thomas Tallis, Nils Lindberg and Benny Andersson.

ai.en: Josef Slunge at Debaser Strand, returning after a collaboration with Håkan Hellström, with a new album on the way.

events.description: Following his collaboration with Håkan Hellström and with a new album on the way, Josef Slunge returns to Debaser with his most organic and personal material to date.

ai.en: A Södermalm food walk with Moveat, tasting dishes and drinks at several stops.

events.description: Discover Södermalm through its food and drinks together with friends, family, or a date. Your ticket includes several tasting portions from carefully selected stops around town. Visit restaurants, delis, and bakeries, and let your taste buds dance through fine dining, street food, and local culinary arts in bite-sized formats. events.description: Join us on an exciting guided wine tour! Visit 4 different bars where you will taste a new delicious wine at each bar. Throughout the tour you will also be guided by a sommelier who will tell you everything about the different wines you taste, such as their grape varieties, wine region and what best goes with the wine. It will be a unique and exciting way to discover new wonderful places in Stockholm, Gamla Stan, while learning more about wine.

ai.en: Vivaldi & Co. at Dieselverkstaden, classical masterpieces by Vivaldi and others in a new light.

events.description: Classical Masterpieces in a New Light Experience the classical music of the great master Vivaldi and others as you’ve never heard it before! The Swedish Wind Ensemble invites you to a concert where you can enjoy these well-known pieces up close, performed in arrangements for wind orchestra. The concert is conducted by Maria Itkonen, with Johanna Orrje as soloist on oboe.

ai.en: Djungelboken The Musical at Göta Lejon in Stockholm, a bigger and wilder jungle adventure based on Kipling's stories. The show has drawn over 200,000 visitors.

events.description: DJUNGELBOKEN -- THE MUSICAL ETT HELT GALET DJUNGELÄVENTYR -- NU STÖRRE, VILDARE OCH MER SPEKTAKULÄRT! Efter att ha trollbundit över 200.000 besökare är succén tillbaka -- större än någonsin! Följ med på en oförglömlig resa in i den exotiska indiska djungeln och möt de legendariska karaktärerna Baloo, Bagheera, Kaa och den fruktade Shere Kahn. Med humor, fantastisk musik och hisnande akrobatik bjuder Dröse & Norberg på en föreställning som får hela familjen att ryckas med. På scenen står en stor ensemble med några av Sveriges absolut främsta musikalartister. Tillsammans skapar de en show fylld av energi, skratt och magi som måste upplevas live. title.en: Celebrate St. Martin's Day on Långholmen

ai.en: St. Martin's goose dinner at Långholmens Wärdshus in Stockholm, a traditional autumn menu the restaurant has served for over 25 years.

events.description: The feast of St. Martin’s Eve used to be celebrated throughout Sweden but is today primarily associated with the southern parts of Sweden. However, Långholmens restaurant in Stockholm has served the classic goose dinner every autumn for over 25 years. The St. Martin’s goose menu consists of Black soup or pumpkin soup. Goose with traditional sides. Swedish apple cake.

Birdies takes you on a trip through a dreamlike world, where hypnotic sounds meet shimmering pop gems from artists like Björk, The Cranberries, Radiohead, Sara Parkman and Mariam the Believer. Birdies is a choir that never stays quite the same. Always changing shape, sound and repertoire. For over 18 years, they've been putting their own spin on everything from R&B, gospel and pop to hard rock, indie, Americana and songs for broken hearts.

ai.en: Ezhel at Fållan, one of the most influential Turkish rap voices.

events.description: Ezhel — or Sercan İpekçioğlu, as he is actually named — is one of the most influential voices in Turkish rap, with a strong presence on the German scene as well. Born and raised in Ankara and now based in Berlin, he has been shaped by a wide range of influences: hip hop, reggae, and Anatolian rock — a mix that also defines his own sound.

ai.en: A flea market Sunday at Färgfabriken on 8 November, with clothes and vintage finds.

events.description: Welcome to a lovely flea market Sunday at Färgfabriken! On November 8, Smedjan will be filled with clothes, vintage finds, interior pieces, and other treasures waiting for a new home. Bring a friend, browse the stalls, and combine your treasure hunt with brunch or fika at Färgfabriken’s café.

title.en: Fauré's Requiem and the World Premiere by Maria Lithell Flyg

events.description: Two musical works come together in a concert exploring mortality, loss and hope. title.en: Shinedown: DANCE, KID, DANCE ACT II

ai.en: Don Toliver's Nitrous Octane World Tour at Avicii Arena, a melodic rapper and singer blending hip hop, trap and R&B.

events.description: Don Toliver is an American rapper and singer known for his melodic blend of hip-hop, trap, and R&B. His music has gained widespread global popularity, and the 'NITROUS - OCTANE WORLD TOUR' showcases his latest work live on stage.

ai.en: Hommage à Piazzolla at Riddarhuset, a tribute to the tango revolutionary Astor Piazzolla.

events.description: Astor Piazzolla revolutionised tango, forging a bold new musical language where Argentine tradition met classical music, jazz, & rock. This concert celebrates the composer through beloved works including Adiós Nonino, Milonga del Ángel and Oblivion, alongside his virtuosic Hommage à Liège for bandoneon, guitar and strings, featuring bandoneonist Jens Lundberg and guitarist David Härenstam.

ai.en: MAKSIM, a crossover pianist, plays five concerts in Sweden as part of the SEGMENTI World Tour, which covers over 100 performances on four continents. Göta Lejon, Stockholm.

events.description: MAKSIM Världens bästsäljande crossover-pianist SEGMENTI WORLD TOUR Worldberömde crossover?pianisten MAKSIM, en av de bäst säljande inom genren, kommer till Sverige för endast 5 konserter som en del av den hyllade SEGMENTI World Tour. Turnén omfattar över 100 framträdanden på 4 kontinenter, med en förväntad publik på över 500?000 personer. Den virtuose pianisten MAKSIM, vinnare av MTV Music Awards och förstapristagare i prestigefyllda internationella musiktävlingar, kommer att framföra verk från sitt 12:e studioalbum, SEGMENTI, tillsammans med särskilda stycken som har definierat hans karriär. Ikoniska verk av legendariska klassiska tonsättare som Chopin, Prokofjev och Tjajkovskij presenteras sida vid sida med nytolkningar av världskända låtar av Queen, ABBA med flera, berikade med moderna och rockinfluerade arrangemang och framförda i MAKSIMs unika pianostil. Konserten kommer även att inkludera liveframföranden av internationellt hyllade stycken från hans tidigare album, såsom "Exodus", "Pirates of the Caribbean" och "Game of Thrones", vilka alla har varit mycket populära bland publiken. Tillsammans med sitt band på scen lyfter MAKSIM SEGMENTI World Tour långt bortom en traditionell pianokonsert, genom att kombinera kraftfull scenproduktion och visuellt slående effekter till en helhetsupplevelse. Denna speciella kväll utlovar en energifylld, filmisk hyllning till pianomusiken och förvandlar konserten till en oförglömlig liveupplevelse. Med över 5 miljoner sålda album världen…

ai.en: Allt enligt Gert, a conversation at Rival in Stockholm between writer and host Josefine Sundström and architect Gert Wingårdh about how he designs houses.

events.description: Möt människan bakom arkitekturen. Hur tänker Gert Wingårdh när han ritar hus? Vad väcker hans nyfikenhet, vad får honom att tvivla och varifrån kommer modet att tänka stort? I ett nära och personligt samtal möter författaren och programledaren Josefine Sundström en av Sveriges mest välkända arkitekter. Det blir en kväll om kreativitet, drivkraft och livsval, men också om motgångar, oväntade infall och människan bakom de uppmärksammade byggnaderna. Arkitekten Gert Wingårdh firar 75 år i livet, och 50 år som arkitekt. Med sin smittande entusiasm, sitt skarpa öga för form och sin förmåga att göra arkitektur både begriplig och underhållande har Gert Wingårdh blivit en av Sveriges mest folkkära arkitekter och tv-profiler.

ai.en: Niklas Strömstedt's Tyck OM mig at the Royal Swedish Opera, a show with stories and songs from Swedish culture.

events.description: Vilka låtar var det som fick håren på armarna att resa sig? Vad sa Evert Taube när han ringde? Hur tar man sig ur den där förlamande och destruktiva tystnaden och när det plötsligt hänger en kalkon under hakan – vad fan gör man då? Och kärleken – kan man begripa sig på den? Det är där vi är när ridån går upp. TYCK om mig eller Tyck OM mig! Välkomna till mer än bara en konsert!

ai.en: Kerson Leong and Camerata Nordica at the Historiska museet, a programme of Grieg, Max Richter's Recomposed Vivaldi and Piazzolla.

events.description: EDVARD GRIEG Two Melodies, op. 53 MAX RICHTER Recomposed: Vivaldi’s Four Seasons ASTOR PIAZZOLLA Las Cuatro Estaciones Portenas ERNA TAURO Höstvisa Few programs capture the arc of the seasons as vividly as this one, moving from the tender melancholy of a Norwegian spring to the urban heat and longing of a Buenos Aires summer. At the center of the evening stands Canadian violinist Kerson Leong, one of the most compelling soloists of his generation.

ai.en: Kurt and Kio at Teater Tre, a playful show for ages 3 to 6 about imagination and friendship.

events.description: A playful tribute to imagination, friendship and the magic of everyday life. Kurt and Kio are bored – really bored. The kind of bored where you stare at the ceiling and sigh. But Kio has an idea: a fort! The perfect solution to everything. The only problem is, they don’t have one. Their search for the perfect fort becomes an unexpected adventure – right in the living room. A story about friendship, play, and finding magic in the little things.

title.en: Minneskonsert Cornelis Vreeswijk i Katarina kyrka | Onsdag 11 november

events.description: Välkommen till en kväll med Cornelis visor, nya tolkningar och gemensamma minnen. Onsdag den 11 november 2026 samlas vi i Katarina kyrka för årets minneskonsert, där kvällens artister och "Unga tolkar Cornelis" framför hans musik. Kyrkogården är upplyst av marschaller." Den ideella föreningen Cornelis Vreeswijksällskapet vill göra Cornelis visor och dikter tillgängliga för alla och envar. Kom, delta och upplev en tradition sedan 1988, året efter att Cornelis gick ur tiden den 12 november 1987. ai.en: J. Cole's The Fall-Off Tour at Avicii Arena in Stockholm on Wednesday 11 November 2026, starting at 19:30, with music from his new album and earlier hits.

events.description: J. Cole is heading out on The Fall-Off Tour with a stop in Stockholm at Avicii Arena. The show starts at 19:30 on Wednesday 11 November 2026 and promises a major arena night featuring music from his new album alongside earlier favourites. Tickets are sold via Live Nation.

ai.en: The Simon & Garfunkel Story returns to Nya Cirkus in Stockholm in autumn 2026, after ten largely sold-out concerts in 2024 and 2025.

events.description: En av de absolut populäraste hyllningskonserterna i världen "The Simon & Garfunkel Story" kommer åter till Sverige hösten 2026 efter ett stort publiktryck med 10 i stort sett utsålda konserter 2024 och 2025. Föreställningen har hyllats både i Sverige och runt om i världen för sin enormt höga kvalité, The Simon & Garfunkel Story har på ett unikt sätt lyckats att återskapa originalet både visuellt och musikaliskt. Under kvällen får publiken förutom historien om Simon & Garfunkel självklart höra alla stora hits som Mrs Robinson, Bridge Over Troubled Water, Scarborough Fair, The Boxer, The Sound of Silence, samt många fler. Det är kort sagt en kväll fylld med mängder med klassiker som är så nära originalet som det går att komma. De är helt fantastiska i sina prestationer och har fått kritiker och publik att jubla världen över. De är kända från musikaler i Londons West End och The Simon and Garfunkel Story som turnerar för fulla hus i Europa, USA och Kanada. 13 år, oavsett om målsman är med eller ej, med anledning av svenska myndigheters krav om begränsning av höga ljudnivåer för unga. (FoHMFS 2014:15) Arrangör: Besterman Längd: Ca 2 h & 20 min inkl paus Åldersgräns: 13 år Rullstolsplats bokas via info@cirkus.se alt. via Ticketmaster telefon: 077 170 70 70
