title.en: The Streets - A Grand Don’t Come for Free

ai.en: The Streets' A Grand Don't Come for Free at Fållan in Stockholm. Doors at 19:00 and start at 20:00. Ages 18 and over.

events.description: Dörrar: 19.00 Start: 20.00 Åldersgräns: 18 år

ai.en: An Evening With Nicko McBrain at Göta Lejon in Stockholm on 11 November 2026, with stories and audience questions from the former drummer of Iron Maiden.

events.description: Efter mer än fyra decennier bakom trummorna och en karriär som gjort honom till en av heavy metals mest inflytelserika musiker kommer Nicko McBrain till Sverige med An Evening With Nicko McBrain. Den 11 november 2026 intar han Göta Lejon i Stockholm för en unik kväll med berättelser, publikfrågor och minnen från ett liv i hårdrockens absoluta toppskikt. Turnén följer utgivningen av Nicko McBrains kommande självbiografi Hello Boys and Girls!, som släpps den 22 oktober 2026. Under kvällen tar McBrain med publiken på en resa genom sin uppväxt i östra London, vägen till Iron Maiden och livet som en av heavy metals mest inflytelserika trummisar. Nicko McBrain anslöt till Iron Maiden 1982 och blev snabbt en viktig del av bandets klassiska sättning. Under sina 42 år i bandet medverkade han på 14 studioalbum, otaliga världsturnéer och bidrog till att forma soundet hos ett av hårdrockens mest framgångsrika band genom tiderna. Men An Evening With Nicko McBrain handlar om mer än bara Iron Maiden. Med sin karaktäristiska humor och berättarglädje delar han med sig av historier från ett liv fyllt av musik, vänskap, motgångar och framgångar. Från de tidiga åren på Londons musikscen till världsturnéer, livet bakom kulisserna i ett av världens största hårdrocksband och de erfarenheter som format honom både som musiker och människa.

ai.en: Bromander live at Twang in Stockholm, an alternative pop and rock artist whose music blends indie pop with personal lyrics.

events.description: Bromander is an artist in the alternative pop/rock genre with a growing listener base. His music, including tracks like 'I detta paradis' and 'Ny människa', is characterized by a blend of indie pop and personal lyrics.

ai.en: Klara Zangerl at Haymarket by Scandic, a Wednesday showcase at Americain for up-and-coming Swedish talent.

events.description: Every Wednesday, Americain transforms into Haymarket's very own live stage, spotlighting the next generation of Swedish music. Klara Zangerl's taking the stage at Haymarket with her music that moves between dreamy alternative pop and atmospheric electronic soundscapes. Discover one of Sweden's most exciting new voices - before everyone else does.

ai.en: A cinnamon bun baking workshop at Vaxholm's Bed and Breakfast.

events.description: During a few hours in the kitchen at Vaxholm’s Bed & Breakfast, participants will learn the secret to baking truly juicy cinnamon buns. The workshop is held in small groups of up to six people. The session concludes with a tasting of the freshly baked buns, and each participant will receive a dozen to take home. The activity is suitable for ages 13 and up. For more details and to book a spot, visit the organiser’s website.

title.en: Looksmaxxing or Old Money Face – can everyone become perfect?

ai.en: Looksmaxxing or Old Money Face at Tekniska museet, a talk on whether everyone can become perfect and the beauty technology behind it.

events.description: The perfect body has become a technology project. In a conversation about looksmaxxing, old money face and today’s beauty ideals, Erik Galli, Emma Severinsson and Ata Ghaderi explore how new technology shapes our views on beauty, healthcare and self-optimization – and who can afford to live up to the ideals. The discussion moves between historical beauty standards, new technologies and the body as a status marker. Moderated by Samanda Ekman, in collaboration with Kvinnohistoriska.

ai.en: Josiah and the Bonnevilles at Debaser Strand, playing the new album As Is.

events.description: Josiah and the Bonnevilles take the stage at Debaser Strand with the new album As Is! Tennessee-born Josiah Leming has built his career from the ground up – from living out of his car and playing for anyone willing to listen, to sold-out tours and a devoted fanbase he himself named the Bonnevilles. Since releasing his first demos in 2007, his powerful storytelling has established him as one of the most genuine voices in the modern Americana scene.

ai.en: The Stockholm International Film Festival 2026, a film festival with screenings across the city.

events.description: Whether you want to be moved, surprised, inspired, or simply escape into another world for a while, the Stockholm International Film Festival is the place to be. The program features everything from glamorous Red-Carpet screenings, gala premieres, and award-winning festival favorites to Face2Face conversations with directors and actors. It’s not just about watching films. It’s about truly experiencing them together.

title.en: Jenny & Tassos Duo – Acoustic Pop, Folk and Country

ai.en: Jenny and Tassos Duo at Teater Bristol, acoustic pop, folk and country with storytelling.

events.description: Jenny & Tassos Duo presents an acoustic concert centred on melodies and storytelling. Their music moves between singer-songwriter, country, folk and acoustic pop, ranging from reflective moments to songs with warmth, energy and rhythm. Singer-songwriter Jenny Holmgren and Tasso create an intimate musical setting in which vocals, guitar and piano take centre stage.

title.en: Needle felting & Embroidery Jewellery with Ran

ai.en: A needle felting and embroidery jewellery workshop with Ran at Presentmakeriet in Stockholm, held in English. Each participant makes a pair of earrings.

events.description: Discover the art of combining wool, needle felting, and embroidery to create your own unique pair of earrings. By the end of the workshop, you’ll have a pair of handmade earrings that are entirely your own. The workshop is held in English.

ai.en: The Wallflowers at Fållan on 12 November, a two-part concert.

events.description: On November 12, The Wallflowers take the stage at Fållan for a unique two-part concert. First, they will perform the entire Bringing Down the Horse album, and after a short break, they return to play the full Long After Dark by Tom Petty and the Heartbreakers. A one-of-a-kind double bill for fans of melodic rock and storytelling songs

title.en: A Tribute to the Women in Soul & Jazz

ai.en: A Tribute to the Women in Soul and Jazz at Kristinehovs malmgård, celebrating women from Ella Fitzgerald onward.

events.description: Join Cilla Ribbing Band & guests for an evening celebrating iconic women who shaped jazz and soul – from Ella Fitzgerald and Monica Zetterlund to Aretha Franklin. Expect groove, elegance, soul and powerful musical moments in the beautiful Kristina Hall at historic Kristinehovs Malmgård – a unique 18th-century setting in the heart of Södermalm. Ticket including coffee/tea & cookies.

ai.en: Kyle Alessandro at Debaser Nova, from the Eurovision stage, with his album AURA.

events.description: From the Eurovision stage to Debaser Nova. This November, Kyle Alessandro comes to Stockholm with his album AURA and the launch of his first-ever European headline tour.

ai.en: A talk on buttons, collars and jackets at the Spårvägsmuseet, about tram uniforms around 1900.

events.description: A tram conductor around 1900 stood ramrod straight in a strict, dark uniform with shiny buttons and a high collar. Today you are greeted by a customer host in soft, functional workwear. In this talk we travel through the history of uniforms alongside the history of fashion: how hemlines, cuts, colors and materials have reflected the ideals of their time, from horse-drawn trams to today. In collaboration with the museum's Friends association. Talk, 1 hour. At Spårvägsmuseet, tickets required.

ai.en: Reality, an interactive Swedish-language film experience at Konträr, where the audience watches a feature being filmed and can become extras.

events.description: In Reality, the audience follows the filming of a feature film, and may even become part of the movie as extras. Using technology and AI, the room transforms into various environments, from a cottage in Hälsingland to a spaceship. The performance explores what makes life real and our longing to truly feel alive.

ai.en: AW Create at Presentmakeriet, a relaxed evening of crafting with bubbly and snacks.

events.description: A relaxing moment with bubbly, snacks, and stress-free crafting. Bring your colleagues, friends – or come by yourself and hang out in a warm, creative environment on Södermalm in Stockholm. We set out all the materials and inspiring seasonal ideas. Follow clear step-by-step instructions or create completely freely – the choice is yours. This is all about the joy of creating, good company, and easing gently into the weekend. For groups of 4 people or more, you can book other time slots.

title.en: Below Zero - In Praise of Shadows

ai.en: Below Zero's In Praise of Shadows at Nya Cirkus in Stockholm, a circus show with seven acrobats moving to newly written folk music.

events.description: Poetisk värme och hisnande energi när Cirkuskompaniet Below Zero står på scen In Praise of Shadows är en hyllning till skuggorna inom oss såväl som runt oss. Med en scenografi som för tankarna till bergen, haven, vågorna och glaciären rör sig sju akrobater till tonerna av nyskriven folkmusik som framförs live på scen. Viskande fioler övergår till trummor och club beats. Catwalk i haute couture varvas med riskfyllda balansakter och halsbrytande volter. Kroppar slungas flera meter upp i luften för att gestalta naturens kraft och skörhet när cirkuskonst tar formen av stormande hav och svepande trädkronor. En storslagen helhet, en hyllning till naturen och en hommage till det ofullkomliga. En familjeföreställning med svindlande akrobatik och nyskriven livemusik. Cirkuskompaniet Below Zeros In Praise of Shadows är en visuell och fysisk storm som beskrivs som vild, vacker och oförutsägbar. Föreställningslängd: 60 min. Rekommenderas från 7 år Om kompaniet Below Zero är ett svenskt cirkuskompani baserat i Stockholm. Deras konstnärliga uttryck tar avstamp i det nordiska klimatet, där kyla och utsatthet kontrasteras mot värme, närhet och mänskliga möten. Namnet Below Zero syftar till artisternas förmåga att trotsa tyngdlagen, att flyga nästan som fallande snöflingor. Kompaniet turnerar både nationellt och internationellt.

ai.en: Benjamin Ingrosso's first arena tour, What Happens Next?, at Avicii Arena.

events.description: Benjamin Ingrosso embarks on his first arena tour What Happens Next?, visiting major indoor arenas across the Nordics in autumn 2026. The tour culminates with two shows at Avicii Arena in Stockholm on November 13 and 14. Fans can expect a spectacular live production with pop hits and creative visuals.

ai.en: The Bausa, a Norwegian house trio, at Fållan as part of their European tour.

events.description: The Norwegian house trio The Bausa is coming to Stockholm as part of their European tour. Don’t miss their concert at Fållan on November 13!

events.venue: The Laugh House på Scandic Klara

ai.en: Fuzz Festival 2026 at Debaser Strand in Stockholm, a two-day festival with two stages and fifteen bands, organised around Truckfighters.

events.description: Get ready for a journey straight into the world of fuzz at Truckfighters Fuzz Festival 2026. Experience incredible bands, an amazing atmosphere, and a legendary concert venue. Two days, two stages, fifteen bands.

ai.en: Hobo Comedy at Hobo Stockholm, an evening of stand-up with MC Kathryn LeRoux and DJ Erik Pope.

events.description: Step into a thoughtfully crafted evening of stand-up comedy with MC Kathryn LeRoux and DJ Erik Pope. Expect a rotating lineup of comedians performing in both English and Swedish. Each show unfolds around a theme, giving the night its own personality and flow. Come curious. Stay present. Enjoy a laid-back night that feels intimate, easygoing, and a little unexpected.

ai.en: The Language Party at Tranströmerbiblioteket, celebrating languages, multilingualism and storytelling from around the world.

events.description: We celebrate language, multilingualism and storytelling from different parts of the world. International guests (incl ALMA-awarded Argentinian Isol and Libanese children's books illustrator Maya Fidawa), stage talks, activities for children, storytimes, book and author presentations — and a book fair with books for children and young people.

ai.en: F#ck Marry Kill, an improv comedy show by Presens Impro at PIK Vasastan, based on the party game.

events.description: In "F#ck Marry Kill," Presens Impro brings the concept from the classic game of the same name to the comedy stage. On stage are some of the country's funniest improvisers, ready to dive into sketches inspired by the show's three sacred themes: fuck, marry, and kill. The show takes you from awkward dates and chaotic weddings to murderous dinner parties – and everything in between. Quite simply, improv comedy exactly the way it should be!

ai.en: Christmas at Taxinge Näsby 2026, one of Sweden's largest Christmas fairs, with more than 100 craftspeople.

events.description: One of Sweden's largest Christmas fairs at Taxinge Castle, featuring over 100 of the country's best craftsmen. Visitors can explore handmade products and solve their Christmas gift needs in a single day.

title.en: For The Discrimination Podcast X Clarion Hotel: Singles Day

ai.en: Fördomspodden, a comedy interview show by Emil Persson, at Clarion Hotel Sign for Singles Day.

events.description: Journalist and host Emil Persson brings his comedic interview concept Fördomspodden to Clarion Hotel Sign. Together with Hanna Friberg and Kalle Norwald, he examines prejudices about love, dating, and relationships. Expect laughs, drinks, power ballads, and a chance for the audience to share their own prejudices. A full evening with pre-party vibes promised!

ai.en: An opera at Folkoperan in which a teenager named Aisha discovers a powerful voice and is drawn into her own heritage, confronting her father and mother.

events.description: Aisha hears a powerful voice. It is as unreal and beautiful and seductive as it is frightening. Through music, she is drawn into an unknown world far away from the life of a teenager – on a journey deep into her own heritage, where she is forced to confront her father, her mother, and the raging female force – the Queen of the Night, or the Jinn. A musical monologue in Swedish by Bahar Pars, featuring music by Mozart, Puccini, and others. Performed in the foyer of Folkoperan.

What happens when artists create without asking whether the work is socially acceptable, fits market demands, or follows the rules? What happens when artists are just free to create? Chisel Studios is bringing together a collective of local artists for an exhibition exploring what it means to create freely — not for the sake of what is expected, accepted, or commercially viable, but simply for the sake of art, spiritual connection, and emotional release.

ai.en: Mat för livet 2026 at Kistamässan, Sweden's largest gluten- and lactose-free food fair, with tastings, lectures and expert questions.

Lyssna på föreläsningar, delta i tävlingar och ställ dina frågor till experter. Vi hälsar dig varmt välkommen att prova, jämföra och upptäcka viner från några av Frankrikes främsta vinregioner! Svenska vinimportörer finns på plats för att guida dig genom provningarna och hjälpa dig att hitta nya favoriter. Utöver vinerna kan du även njuta av franska ostar, charkuterier och många andra delikatesser. Alla matprodukter finns även till försäljning på plats. title.en: Svartklubben - Mat & Musik i Mörker - Lunch

ai.en: A lunch session at Svartklubben in Stockholm, a dark dining experience with food, specially composed music and sensory experiences, guided by visually impaired hosts.

events.description: På den legala Svartklubben får du njuta av läcker mat, specialkomponerad musik och fantastiska sinnesupplevelser. Här får du rika möjligheter att utforska mat, dryck och underhållning på ett nytt sätt! Hur fungerar det att kommunicera utan syn för dig och din grupp? Fascineras av synskadade sjungande servitörer. Utmana dig själv och ät en unik måltid! Det här är garanterat en stark upplevelse med många nya dimensioner. Skrämmande? Ingen fara. Det här mörkret är varmt och välkomnande! ai.en: Bruckner's Mass in F minor performed at Katarina Kyrka in Stockholm, with soloists, Cappella Catharinae and Katarina Kammarkör under Hans Vainikainen.

Agnes Auer, sopran Katija Dragojevic, alt Carl Unander Scarin, tenor Carl Ackerfeldt, bas Cappella Catharinae Katarina Kammarkör Orkestern Filialen Dirigent: Hans Vainikainen Numrerade platser, portarna öppnas kl 17.15.

ai.en: GERD releases her album More Water Than Anything and starts her first Swedish tour in two and a half years at Pustervik in Göteborg on 16 October. The show is at Vasateatern in Stockholm.

events.description: GERD följer upp nya albumet med sin första Sverige-turné på två och ett halvt år Den 25 september släpper GERD albumet "More Water Than Anything" och nu är det klart att hon även ger sig ut på en turné som inleds den 16 oktober på Pustervik i Göteborg. På nya skivan med P3 Guld-vinnaren får det elektroniska, organiska och orkestrala samspela utan att pressas in i en given mall. Slutresultatet låter större och mer kompromisslöst än något hon gjort tidigare. Med albumet "More Water Than Anything" får musikens driv och framåtrörelse förkroppsliga hur skapandekraft kan övervinna tvivel. "Det är det mest personliga jag gjort", säger GERD om skivan. "Jag har inte riktigt vågat öppna den dörren tidigare och det är så klart läskigt men också kul. Det har dessutom gett texterna ett annat djup. " Omgiven av skog, vatten och långa nätter på en avskild ö i Värmland började hon laborera fram låtar parallellt med att en dragning till folktro och väsen växte fram. Undan för undan satte omgivningen -- skogen, tystnaden, känslan av något som rörde sig i utkanten -- spår i det inre och färgade såväl uttryck som innehåll. Trots stora framgångar de senaste åren, med internationell uppmärksamhet, hyllningar för debutsingeln "Lies for a Liar", en P3 Guld-vinst i kategorin Framtidens artist och uppmärksammade liveframträdanden, kom en period för GERD då kreativiteten inte längre kändes självklar. I arbetet med nya skivan blev det viktigt att hitta tillbaka till ett mer intuitivt sätt att skapa…

ai.en: Raymonds Music Café at Bromma Musikscen, a Saturday afternoon with Raymond Björling and Jonas Janson.

events.description: Come together for a Saturday afternoon with Raymond Björling and Jonas Janson. Let yourself be enveloped and warmed by love in various musical forms. A little Jussi, a little Jazz, a little Pop, a little Gospel and gourmet hamburgers with classic accessories.

ai.en: The #Stockholmsjul Christmas lights, with a million LED lights across more than 40 streets and squares in central Stockholm.

events.description: #Stockholmsjul decorates over 40 streets and squares in Stockholm City with one million LED lights.Swedish Christmas traditions are displayed in a modern style, such as moose, cones, deer, spruces, reindeer, angels, and a giant mistletoe. On the website, you can download a map of the Christmas light walks.

ai.en: Ron Pope at Slaktkyrkan, an American songwriter known for A Drop in the Ocean.

events.description: Since breaking through with A Drop in the Ocean, Ron Pope has become one of the most respected songwriters in modern Americana and folk. Blending country, folk and classic American rock, his songs explore love, family and life on the road with warmth and honesty. Expect an intimate concert filled with heartfelt storytelling and timeless melodies.

events.description: Come and experience the musical breadth of the Royal Swedish Orchestra in a new setting. On Saturday evenings, once the matinee audience has gone home, music will be performed in the Golden Foyer. Come on in, have a drink at the bar, and listen as some of our musicians play their personal favourites off-stage.

events.description: On November 14, the French Wine Day celebrates its premiere, offering a day dedicated to French wines and flavors. In addition to wines, French cheeses, charcuterie, and other delicacies will be available.

ai.en: Power Fitness Xpo at Nacka Strandsmässan on 14 and 15 November, a fitness festival returning after its debut.

events.description: After last year’s incredible debut, the ultimate fitness festival is finally back! On 14–15 November, we’re returning to Nacka Strandsmässan – and this year, we’re turning things up a notch. Expect a bigger expo, more energy and even more inspiration!

ai.en: Dave Lofts at Nalen Klubb, an Irish singer-songwriter known for heartfelt songs.

events.description: Irish singer-songwriter Dave Lofts has quickly built a reputation for heartfelt songwriting, soaring melodies and a sound that blends indie folk with modern acoustic pop. Following sold-out tours across Ireland and the UK, he now brings music from his new EP Holy to Sweden. Expect an intimate concert filled with emotional storytelling and singalong-worthy anthems.

title.en: Mamma Moo and Crow’s Christmas – Children’s Theatre in Swedish

ai.en: Mamma Moo and Crow's Christmas at Teater Bristol, a Swedish children's theatre show about a surprise Christmas present for a farmer.

events.description: It is Christmas Eve tomorrow, and Mamma Moo wants to surprise the farmer with an unusual Christmas present. Meanwhile, Crow rushes home to arrange presents for himself. Based on the book by Jujja Wieslander, the story explores friendship, expectations, and what matters most at Christmas. The performance is in Swedish, lasts about 35 minutes and is recommended for children aged 3 and above.

ai.en: Linda Lampenius and Pete Parkkonen in their first joint concert in Stockholm on 15 November at Berns.

events.description: Linda Lampenius and Pete Parkkonen will perform their first-ever joint concert in Stockholm on Sunday, November 15, 2026. The audience can look forward to an energetic and emotionally charged concert featuring Pete Parkkonen’s biggest hits, Linda Lampenius’ beloved songs from the 1990s, and a spectacular live performance of their Eurovision hit Liekinheitin.

ai.en: TEDxStockholm: Human After All at Cirkus, a talk on what it means to be human in a world of algorithms and screens.

events.description: What does it truly mean to be human in a world dominated by algorithms, screens, and rapid change? Join TEDx Stockholm to look inward, strip away the noise, and focus on what connects us at our very core. With the theme "Human after all", the event features 10 speakers, 2 artist performances and more. The event is held in English. Expect a powerful day filled with Ideas Worth Spreading.

ai.en: Hammarby IF against Kristianstads DFF at Hammarby IP on the final matchday of the women's Damallsvenskan.

ai.en: I Can!, a physical theatre show for children aged 2 to 5 at Lilla Tre about learning new things.

events.description: I Can! is a poetic physical theatre adventure for the youngest audiences, about the joy of mastering new things. About the challenge of learning, and the pride of suddenly being able to do something you couldn’t before. Through play, humour and movement, the show inspires self-confidence, courage to try again when things go wrong, and creative problem-solving. title.en: Happy Voices under ledning av Gabriel Forss. Gäst: Uno Sveningsson

ai.en: Happy Voices, a choir conducted by Gabriel Forss, gives a closing concert with gospel, Swedish pop, soul, rock and musical numbers at Filadelfia Convention Center. Uno Sveningsson is the guest.

events.description: Varmt välkommen på konsert med kören Happy Voices, under ledning av körledare Gabriel Forss. Kören har repeterat och finslipat repertoaren under hösten och nu när det är dags för avslutningskonsert bjuds det på en härlig blandad repertoar med allt från gospel, svensk pop, soul, rock och musikal. Kvällens konsert gästas av ingen mindre än fantastiska Uno Svenningsson! Det här kommer att bli en härlig kväll! OM Happy Voices Happy Voices (tidigare Du kan sjunga gospel) startade upp i Stockholm år 2004. Kören finns till för alla som vill vara med och sjunga! Sedan flera år tillbaka finns kören också i Malmö & Göteborg. Happy Voices mål är att vara en öppen, varm, välkomnande, personlig kör där glädje, energi, uppmärksamhet och omsorg står i centrum. Aktuell forskning visar att körsång är friskvård! OM Gabriel Forss Gabriel Forss är en av Sveriges främsta körledare och en folkkär allsångsledare, som sprider glädje över hela landet med sina sångprojekt. Gabriels karriär startade i Melodifestivalen med låten "Bara hon älskar mig" och gruppen Blond, som vann och representerade Sverige i Dublin år 1997. Genom åren har Gabriel varit körledare för soul- och gospelkören "One Voice", programledare för "Förfest hos Gabriel", medverkat i "Körslaget" och "Så ska det låta" samt varit programvärd för "Karlavagnen" i Sveriges Radio m.m. Han har släppt självbiografin "Äntligen" och skivan "Äntligen Jul". OM Uno Svenningsson Uno Svenningsson har en lång och framgångsrik karriär både som…

ai.en: Amirae at Haymarket by Scandic, neo soul and contemporary R&B presented with Kommon Musik.

Known for her magnetic live presence, AMIRAE is part of a new generation redefining neo soul and R&B with depth, intention and emotional clarity. This is a free event, come early to guarantee a seat.

title.en: Israel Galván - La Edad de Oro

ai.en: Israel Galván's La Edad de Oro at Dansens Hus in Stockholm, a flamenco work that has become a cornerstone of his repertoire and is returning two decades after its premiere.

events.description: Flamencovärldens främsta avantgardist Israel Galván är tillbaka på Dansens Hus! Föreställningen La Edad de Oro är ett verk som blivit en hörnsten i Galváns repertoar och satt avtryck världen över. Två decennier efter premiären kan du äntligen se den igen. I "La Edad de Oro" söker Galván inte bara efter flamencons rötter -- han blottlägger dem. Tillsammans med María Marín och Rafael Rodríguez etablerar Galván en scenisk dynamik som fördjupar verkets stringenta karaktär. Genom att skala bort det dekorativa och fokusera på det essentiella uppstår en rå närvaro där kropp, röst och strängar samverkar i ett ofiltrerat uttryck. Föreställningen är inte nostalgisk, utan ett samtida svar på en förlorad form -- en flamenco som brinner, bryter och berör. "For me, it's about surrendering to the silence, with the memory of the guitar and the singing. The dancer's body is a symphony of movements and a musical instrument. 'Edad de Oro' is my personal dance laboratory." -- Israel Galván Föreställningslängd: 1 timme 40 minuter Israel Galván är en banbrytande spansk koreograf och dansare, född i Sevilla i en familj av flamencodansare. Efter klassisk flamencoutbildning har han sedan debuten med verket ¡Mira! / Los zapatos rojos (1998) omformat flamencodansen till ett samtida och gränsöverskridande uttryck. Hans verk präglas av en fysisk dekonstruktion av flamenco, där han lånar rörelseelement från tjurfäktning, fotboll, aktivism och queera scenuttryck. Galván har tilldelats flera…

ai.en: Tove Lo's ESTRUS at Avicii Arena in Stockholm, presented as a show by the pop artist known for openness about sex, addiction and vulnerability.

events.description: Few artists have changed the playing field of modern pop as much as Tove Lo in the past decade. With an almost diary-like approach and an unfiltered openness about sex, addiction, vulnerability, and destructiveness, she has become both a global pop star and an obvious reference point for the generation of artists who have come after her. On September 18, the new album “ESTRUS” will be released, and shortly thereafter, Tove Lo will stop by Avicii Arena in Stockholm for her biggest home concert ever on November 19.

title.en: Tomten är far till alla barnen

ai.en: Tomten är far till alla barnen, a children's show based on the 1999 cult film, touring Swedish arenas after sold-out runs at Cirkus in Stockholm.

events.description: TOMTEN ÄR FAR TILL ALLA BARNEN Efter utsålda föreställningar, publikens skratt och hyllningar från både kritiker och publik under 2024/2025 på Cirkus i Stockholm, så återvänder nu scensuccén Tomten är far till alla barnen till utvalda arenor i Sverige. När den folkkära kultfilmen från 1999 för första gången tog steget upp på scen 2024 skapades en helt ny svensk jultradition. På scenen fick publiken följa den numera legendariska julaftonen där Sara bjuder hem sina tre ex-män och deras nya familjer för att fira jul tillsammans med sin motvilliga sambo Janne. Det som skulle bli en idyllisk familjehögtid utvecklas snabbt till ett explosivt kaos där gamla relationer, hemligheter och konflikter briserar inför julgranen. Regissören Rikard Bergqvist förvandlade filmens kultförklarade berättelse till en scenföreställning fylld av högt tempo, fysisk komik, musikinslag och en ensemble i absolut toppklass. Kritiker beskrev resultatet som en skrattfest i rasande tempo där publikens första tvekan snabbt byttes mot rungande skratt. Premiären i Stockholm i november 2024 blev startskottet på en publiksuccé. Föreställningen spelade för fulla hus, hyllades av kvällspressen och fortsatte att växa i popularitet under 2025 -- där den bland annat belönades med "Årets scenföreställning" på Svenska Humorpriset. Den hysteriskt roliga, kärleksfullt kaotiska och fullständigt oförutsägbara julaftonen återvänder 2026 med några av Sveriges mest älskade skådespelare. Möt Liv Mjönäs, Linus Wahlgren, Eva…

ai.en: Dungen releases the album Vidrig vår on 25 September, and its first single En gång i timmen is previewed. The band plays Vasateatern in Stockholm.

events.description: Dungen Det nya Dungen-albumet "Vidrig vår" släpps den 25 september och är en öppen och personlig skildring av en långvarig relations sönderfall. Som första singel från skivan, som hör till det musikaliskt mest nakna de har spelat in, släpps nu "En gång i timmen" -- en låt som både låter omisskännligt Dungen och stakar ut en ny riktning. I höst följer bandet upp albumet med en omfattande Skandinavien-turné med start i Bergen den 22 oktober. Den 20 november spelar bandet på Vasateatern i Stockholm -- biljetterna är släppta! I år är det 25 år sedan Dungen gav ut sitt självbetitlade debutalbum och nya skivan "Vidrig vår", producerad av Gustav Ejstes ihop med trogne vapendragaren Mattias Glavå, är bandets första sedan 2022 års "En är för mycket och tusen aldrig nog". Dungens lika karaktäristiska som dynamiska hybrid av psykrock och folkklanger har trots texter på svenska vunnit dem en månghövdad internationell publik och bland beundrarna märks exempelvis Jack White, Tame Impala och Fleet Foxes. Förutom Gustav Ejstes består Dungen av Reine Fiske (gitarr), Mattias Gustavsson (bas) och Johan Holmegard (trummor). Åldersgräns 18+ http://luger.se www.vasateatern.se

events.description: Stockholms flamencoscen FlamencoFredag återvänder till Dansens hus för att fira flamencokonstens starka närvaro. Studioscen på Dansens Hus förvandlas till en tablao, en flamencoscen där nervkittlande stunder av improvisation möter genomarbetade kompositioner med sång, dans, gitarr och slagverk. Husbandet Tres de Corazones har, flamencodagarna i ära, bjudit in fantastiska gäster till en sprakande, medryckande kväll. Det blir lyriska gitarrsolon, djup sång -- cante jondo och dans fylld med rytmer och styrka. Det mänskliga mötet mellan flamencoutövarna och publiken ligger i fokus. title.en: Westlife 25: The Anniversary World Tour - Avicii Arena

ai.en: Westlife 25: The Anniversary World Tour at Avicii Arena, marking the group's 25th year.

events.description: Westlife returns to Stockholm in 2026 with their anniversary tour Westlife 25 – The Anniversary World Tour. The group will perform their biggest hits and new arrangements in a spectacular arena show at Avicii Arena. Expect a night of pop nostalgia, powerful vocals and unforgettable live moments.

ai.en: Flamenco Friday at Dansens Hus Studioscen, a flamenco tablao with live performances.

events.description: Flamenco Friday transforms Dansens Hus Studioscen into a tablao, a flamenco stage filled with pure flamenco power. Here, thrilling moments of improvisation meet elaborate compositions, as the artists are swept up in the atmosphere and take the audience into the magical world of flamenco. Visitors can expect lyrical guitar solos, deep singing (cante jondo), and dance filled with rhythm and power. The house band Tres de Corazones has invited fantastic guests to create a sparkling, engaging evening.

ai.en: The classic Christmas buffet at Långholmens Wärdshus, a long-running Stockholm tradition.

events.description: Långholmens Wärdshus’s traditional Christmas buffet is a true Stockholm classic that has been a around for many years. Homemade Christmas dishes, prepared using excellent ingredients, are served in a festively decorated 17th-century manor house. The Christmas buffet features around 70 dishes, along with a wide array of delicious accompaniments and Christmas treats.

title.en: Lane 8 - An evening of music and dance

ai.en: Lane 8 at Bar15, an evening of dance music on the dance floor.

events.description: Lane 8 bjuder in till dansgolv på Bar15. Bra musik, trevligt sällskap och kanske lite klumpiga danssteg. Det är en del av hans This Never Happened-turné, så telefonerna stannar i fickan och musiken får full uppmärksamhet. Kom ensam eller ta med en vän!

ai.en: An archipelago Christmas dinner at Fjäderholmarnas Krog, marking 20 years of Gert Klötzke's Christmas buffet.

events.description: Celebrate 20 years of Gert Klötzke’s iconic Christmas buffet at Fjäderholmarnas Krog! Since 2006, classic Swedish Christmas flavours have met creative new dishes in smaller portions. Enjoy around 125 flavours, including festive favourites, game and exciting new creations – all in a magical archipelago setting.

ai.en: Italienska vindagen 2026, a day of Italian wines at Grand Hotel in Stockholm, with Swedish importers and producers guiding tastings and travel tips for Italy.

events.description: Varmt välkommen till dagen då du kan prova viner från många av Italiens hörn! Svenska vinimportörer och producenter finns på plats och hjälper dig att hitta dina favoritviner. I år kan du också få tips för en härlig semester i Italien på tema vin & gastronomi. Du kommer även att kunna provsmaka italienska ostar, charkuterier och många andra delikatesser. Matprodukterna går också att handla på plats! Datum: Lördagen 21 november 2026 Tider: Dagen är indelad i 3 pass: kl.12.00 - 14:00 kl.15.00 - 17.00 kl.18.00 - 20.00 Plats: Grand Hotel i Stockholm- Vinterträdgården

ai.en: Anden i glaset 2026 at Gröna Lund, a paranormal illusionist and mentalist's new show.

events.description: After several sold out tours, Paranormal Illusionist & Mentalist Anthony Charles Heads is back with a brand new show this Autumn - Anden I Glaset: 2026. Experience Anthony's unique blend of mentalism, psychological influence, mind reading, "paranormal" demonstrations and inexplicable events in this love letter to Victorian Spiritualism, fake seance and showmanship. Expect to be amazed, confused and maybe a little creeped out. Age limit: 14 years and up.

ai.en: Glaive's God Save The Three show at Fryshuset in Stockholm, with Kurtains as support. Doors at 18:30 and show at 19:30. Ages 13 and over.

events.description: Support: Kurtains Dörrar: 18:30 Show: 19:30 Åldersgräns: 13år

ai.en: Saint Levant's AFANDI World Tour has moved from Fållan to Annexet in Stockholm. Doors at 19:00. Ages 13 and over. Only bags up to A4 size are allowed.

events.description: OBS! Saint Levant byter arena från Fållan till Annexet. Dörrar 19:00 Åldersgräns 13 år Endast väskor i A4-storlek eller mindre får tas med in. Only bags up to A4 size are allowed inside.

title.en: Eric Ericsons kammarkör: Nattsånger – en stund av stillhet

ai.en: Eric Ericsons Kammarkör's Nattsånger concert at Katarina Kyrka in Stockholm, a short programme of quiet music under conductor Olof Boman.

events.description: När dagen går mot sitt slut och tystnaden lägger sig bjuder Eric Ericsons Kammarkör in till en stund att landa i, där tankarna får stillna och musiken blir ett andrum innan natten tar vid. Tillsammans med dirigenten Olof Boman får vi en ljuspunkt i novembermörkret, ett kort program där stillhet, värme och eftertanke står i centrum. Här möts musik från olika tider och traditioner i en gemensam nattlig klangvärld, från medeltidens mystik hos Hildegard von Bingen och Heliga Birgitta, till vår tids meditativa toner hos Arvo Pärt, Paul Mealor och James MacMillan. I programmet ryms också Felix Mendelssohn-Bartholdys romantik, den sensuella klangrikedomen hos Jean-Yves Daniel-Lesur och Sven-David Sandströms vibrerande närvaro. Tillsammans bildar de ett stilla flöde av musik, ibland som en viskning, ibland som en varm körklang som fyller rummet. När Eric Ericson grundade Eric Ericsons Kammarkör 1945 lade han grunden till en ensemble som skulle komma att forma svenskt körliv i generationer. Kören har sedan dess etablerat sig som en av världens främsta inom sitt fält. Med en repertoar som sträcker sig från tidig vokalmusik till nutida kompositioner har den blivit känd för sin stilistiska bredd, precision och karakteristiska klang. Program: Paul Mealor: Now Sleeps The Crimson Petal ur Now Sleeps The Crimson Petal Felix Mendelssohn-Bartholdy: Mitten wir im Leben sind ur Kirchenmusik, Op. 23 Sven-David Sandström: Let him kiss me ur Four Songs of Love Heliga Birgitta: Benedictus sis tu…

ai.en: Curious about Space, a concert by the Lönneberga Quartet inspired by meeting the astronaut Christer Fuglesang, at Katarina församlingshus.

events.description: Curious about Outer Space. Inspired by meeting the astronaut Christer Fuglesang, the Lönneberga Quartet has created a family performance for all ages. The music dreams and swings through 14 billion years - Star Wars, Strauss, facts, and dreams, as well as stories from the quartet's meeting with Sweden's first astronaut. Free admission. Language - Swedish.

ai.en: A Christmas dinner at Kafé Källtorp, a sensory meal themed on fire, the seasons and nature.

events.description: The Christmas dinner at Kafé Källtorp is a holistic experience for all the senses, centred around the themes of fire, the forest and togetherness. We offer an unforgettable evening with a crackling fire, candles and Christmas decorations in our cosy conservatory. Here, you can linger together, let the conversation flow and enjoy your dinner in peace and quiet – whilst we bring Christmas to the table in four beautifully presented courses.

ai.en: A beer walk on Södermalm, visiting four pubs and tasting five beers.

events.description: During Taysta's beer walk on Södermalm, you will wander between 4 different pubs and try 5 different beers. Throughout the tour, you will also be accompanied by a beer master who will give all his best tips and tricks along the way. Learn more about the beers you try and everything else related to beer. It will be a fun way to discover new places in beautiful Södermalm. The perfect excursion for all beer lovers!

ai.en: Gershwin to Bernstein at the Royal Swedish Opera, the grand finale of the orchestra's 500th anniversary celebrations.

events.description: As the grand finale to the Royal Swedish Orchestra’s 500th anniversary celebrations, the main stage will come alive with colourful, energetic orchestral music from the USA. Alan Gilbert conducts.

title.en: Christmas at Gröna Lund Amusement Park

ai.en: Barnens Jul, a Christmas world at Gröna Lund amusement park, as the park launches its winter season.

events.description: Groena Lund is launching a brand-new winter season with Barnens Jul, a magical Christmas world in the amusement park's Lilla Område. Children can experience ice shows with the Ice Queen, Christmas candy, illuminated rides, Christmas music, ice skating shows, Gnutt performances, and meet Santa, Mrs. Santa, and the elves.

ai.en: Stockholm Smash Fest 2026, Haunted Edition, a two-day badminton tournament on 21 and 22 November at Sollentuna.

events.description: Stockholm Smash Fest 2026 – Haunted Edition is a two-day badminton tournament on 21–22 November at Sollentuna Rackethall. Organized by Stockholm Sports Familj (SSF), it features Men’s, Women’s and Mixed Doubles across different skill levels. Expect exciting matches, a fun Halloween-inspired atmosphere and a welcoming community spirit. Players, families and spectators are all welcome to join the action!

ai.en: Saint Levant's Afandi world tour at Fållan, a Palestinian singer and rapper blending funk, rock and hip hop.

events.description: Saint Levant is a Palestinian singer and rapper known for blending funk, rock, hip-hop, and rhythm and blues with traditional Palestinian and Algerian rhythms. He is recognized for his multilingual music and has gained global fame with tracks like 'Very Few Friends'. The concert at Fållan in Stockholm is part of his AFANDI WORLD TOUR.

ai.en: Vinterdrömmar, Repliken's first Christmas show at Folkets hus in Tumba, a festive afternoon.

events.description: Welcome to Vinterdrömmar (Winter Dreams) – Repliken’s very first Christmas show! Enjoy a warm and festive afternoon filled with Christmas music, humour, entertainment and unexpected Christmas chaos. Take a seat at a beautifully decorated Christmas table and enjoy Afternoon Tea while Repliken’s ensemble and live band fill Segersjö Folkets hus in Tumba with music, laughter and festive cheer. Your ticket includes the show and Afternoon Tea. Come and celebrate the Christmas season!

title.en: Tätt intill – Jazz and Poetry in Swedish

ai.en: Tätt intill, a jazz and poetry concert in Swedish at Teater Bristol with Stefan Forssén on piano.

events.description: Jazz and poetry meet in Tätt intill, a poetry concert featuring Stefan Forssén on piano and Maria af Malmborg performing vocals and spoken verse. Forssén has composed new music for poems by Bob Hansson, Eva-Stina Byggmästar, Bruno K. Öijer and Göran Sonnevi. Piano, voice and words form a stage experience in which jazz carries, comments on and sometimes challenges the poetry. The performance is in Swedish.

title.en: Bryson Tiller Presents: The Neo Trapsoul Tour
title.fr: Bryson Tiller Presents: The Neo Trapsoul Tour
title.nl: Bryson Tiller Presents: The Neo Trapsoul Tour

ai.en: Bryson Tiller's Neo Trapsoul tour at Avicii Arena, by the GRAMMY-nominated artist from Louisville.

events.description: Bryson Tiller is a GRAMMY-nominated multi-platinum artist from Louisville, Kentucky, renowned for his breakout diamond-certified hit "Don’t" and the groundbreaking album T R A P S O U L (2015), which helped define modern trap R&B. His follow-up, True to Self (2017), debuted at No. 1 on the Billboard 200. The Neo Trapsoul Tour celebrates the 10-year anniversary of T R A P S O U L.

ai.en: Sofia HK at Debaser Nova, returning after her debut album I Norr.

events.description: A Debaser favorite returns this fall! Following last year’s acclaimed debut I Norr and not one but two visits to Debaser, Sofia HK is finally releasing her first full-length album, Flocken. The release will be celebrated at Nova on November 22, and if you haven’t already discovered this folk singer from Jämtland, whose songs speak straight to the listener’s heart, now is the time. Named one of “Sweden’s next big names in music” by GAFFA.

title.en: Autumn concert in the Blue Hall: Kali Malone

ai.en: Kali Malone's autumn concert in the Blue Hall at Stockholm City Hall, by the acclaimed organist and composer.

events.description: Internationally acclaimed organist and composer Kali Malone comes to Stockholm City Hall for this year’s autumn concert. Her minimalist music will meet Ragnar Östberg’s magnificent architecture and the rich sound of the City Hall Organ. An autumn evening for those who want to experience music up close in one of Stockholm’s most unique settings.

ai.en: Desi Dhamaal Vol. 3: Tadka Rewired at Spånga Folkets Hus, an evening of dance, music and culture.

events.description: Desi Dhamaal Vol. 3: Tadka Rewired is an evening of dance, music and culture. Dancers and performers present original pieces inspired by different cultures, followed by DJ sets and street food. The event is organised by Prerna Kalakaar and is open to all ages.

title.en: Crochet a granny square or keep knitting with EvaLotta

ai.en: A crochet and knitting session with EvaLotta at Presentmakeriet, for continuing a teddy bear, rabbit or accessory.

events.description: For those who want to continue knitting a teddy bear or a rabbit, or work on accessories: bring along the project you are currently working on, or start a new one. A warm welcome to a cozy time together!

ai.en: CABAL and Employed To Serve at Kollektivet Livet, a co-headline show of metalcore and thrash.

events.description: CABAL and Employed To Serve are coming to Stockholm for a co-headline show. Employed To Serve combine metalcore, thrash and groove with soaring melodies, while CABAL deliver pitch-black deathcore rooted in death metal, hardcore and electronic music. Danish band Cold Culture open the night with their emotionally charged, electronic-infused post-hardcore.

ai.en: Gula Änglarna's winter concert 2026 at Oscarskyrkan in Stockholm, with Tomas Ledin, Helen Sjöholm, Anna Stadling, Lena Endre and Gladys del Pilar, with proceeds going to people living in homelessness.

events.description: Gula Änglarnas årliga vinterkonsert i Oscarskyrkan med Tomas Ledin, Helen Sjöholm, Anna Stadling, Lena Endre och Gladys del Pilar tillsammans med gospelkören Gladness. Konserten hålls till förmån för Gula Änglarnas verksamhet. Hela behållningen går oavkortat till människor som lever i hemlöshet, ungdomar & pensionärer i svårt utsatta situationer. Insläppstid: 18:00 Längd: 85 min Julkonsert

ai.en: KAJ at Göta Lejon in Stockholm, a show by the band behind the 2025 hit Bara Bada Bastu. No age limit.

events.description: Konserten arrangeras av FKP Scorpio Åldersgräns: Ingen åldersgräns ------------------------------------------------------ Om 2025 hade ett soundtrack så stavades det "Bara Bada Bastu". Det som började som en bastudoftande, glimt-i-ögat-hyllning till nordisk kultur exploderade till ett fullskaligt popfenomen. "Bara Bada Bastu" sköt rakt upp till #1 på Spotify i både Sverige och Finland och toppade listor över hela Norden och Baltikum -- för att sedan ta klivet ut i världen med en raketstart på Spotify Global och #1 på Viral 50 Global. Och som ett extra vedträ i en redan ångande het bastu blev låten nominerad till en Grammis. Bakom succén KAJ står trion Kevin Holmström, Axel Åhman och Jakob Norrgård -- uppvuxna i Vörå i Finland, där allt började redan 2009. Med kvicka texter, nostalgiska flirtar och en varm kärlek till den finlandssvenska kulturen byggde de tidigt en egen musikalisk värld baserad på lika delar nordiska folkmelodier, modern pop och scenisk humor. Det lokala blev snabbt nationellt. Och därefter internationellt. Resan har kantats av utsålda turnéer, album och en historisk seger i Melodifestivalen 2025, där KAJ blev den första finlandssvenska akten att representera Sverige i Eurovision. Nu väntar en ny Sverigeturné. Och KAJ tänker inte göra någon halvmesyr. Räkna med allsång som lyfter taket, koreografier du inte visste att du kunde, bastuvärme i novembermörkret och en show där humor går hand i hand med hitkänsla.

ai.en: Team Putte with guest Evelina Gard at Filadelfia Convention Center in Stockholm, a gospel, pop and soul concert celebrating Gard's 25 years as an artist.

events.description: Välkommen till en konsert med Team Putte! Kören som sjunger gospel, pop, soul och någon visa. Det blir en blandning av låtar där förhoppningsvis flera av dem ska passa dina öron. Den här gången har vi med oss gästartisten Evelina Gard som i år firar 25 år som artist. Evelina har genom åren släppt flera album, lett körer, haft sångelever samt skrivit och arrangerat musik. Vi är så glada att Evelina är med oss den här kvällen och vi ska göra vårt bästa för att detta ska bli en kväll att minnas.

ai.en: A Christmas buffet at La Botanica that brings Swedish Christmas classics together with flavours from around the world.

events.description: Enjoy a culinary journey where Swedish Christmas classics meet flavors from around the world, with hot favorites, cold delicacies and desserts from our very own bakery. Perfect for events, conferences, families and friends, with space for up to 1,000 guests.

title.en: Sjung för mig Arja! Sa Mikis

ai.en: Sjung för mig Arja! at Oscarsteatern, an evening with Arja Saijonmaa on peace, freedom and democracy.

events.description: Arja Saijonmaa bjuder in till en kväll som börjar på vita duken och slutar på scen. En kväll för fred, frihet och demokrati. Dokumentärfilmen ”Sjung för mig Arja!” (regi: Marko Talli) tecknar ett nära porträtt av hennes liv och hennes livslånga vänskap med Mikis Theodorakis. Efter filmen kliver Arja upp på scen och bjuder på en konsert.

ai.en: Omah Lay at Fållan, a Nigerian singer and producer known for Afro-fusion.

events.description: Omah Lay is a Nigerian singer, songwriter, and producer known for his unique Afro-fusion style. He rose to fame in 2020 with his debut EP *Get Layd*, which topped the Nigerian charts and included hit singles like 'Bad Influence' and 'You'. His music blends elements of Afrobeat, soul, and R&B, and he has been praised for his distinctive vocals and introspective lyrics. Omah Lay has also collaborated with international artists like Justin Bieber, further establishing himself as one of Africa’s most promising talents.

ai.en: beabadoobee's The Powerlines tour at Fryshuset, the Filipino-British singer-songwriter.

events.description: Beabadoobee, also known as Beatrice Kristi Ilejay Laus, is a Filipino-British singer-songwriter renowned for her unique blend of indie, alternative pop, and 90s-inspired rock. She gained fame with her song "Coffee", which went viral on TikTok and was later sampled in Powfu’s "Death Bed (Coffee for Your Head)". She has released critically acclaimed albums such as *Fake It Flowers* and *Beatopia*, and her latest album *This Is How Tomorrow Moves* topped the UK charts. The concert is part of her "The Powerlines Tour".

ai.en: An author talk with Nelio Biedermann at Kulturhuset Stadsteatern, in conversation with Cecilia Hansson.

events.description: Meet Nelio Biedermann in conversation with Cecilia Hansson. Switzerland’s new literary star made his debut as an author at the age of 20 and has achieved a major international breakthrough with his second novel, "Lázár". Join him on International Writers' Stage November International Writers' Stage for a conversation about the book.

ai.en: Swan Lake with a live orchestra, performed by International Festival Ballet at Göta Lejon in Stockholm.

events.description: International Festival Ballet presenterar en av de mest kända baletterna till musiken av Pjotr Iljitj Tjajkovskijs "Svansjön". För många är "Svansjön" synonymt med balett. Den romantiska sagan om den unge prinsen Siegfried, som förälskar sig i svanprinsessan Odetta och vill befria henne från hertig Rothbarts onda förtrollning, är en berättelse om den sanna kärlekens kraft. Detta balettstycke ingår i standardrepertoaren hos alla större kompanier. I synnerhet Allegro Moderato från Svanedanserna i akt 2, koreograferad av Lev Ivanov, har varit föremål för otaliga parodier och är därför känd långt utanför den balettintresserade allmänheten som "De fyra små svanarnas dans". Kort sagt är det ett genialt verk av en genialisk kompositör och har varit en publikdragare i århundraden. "Svansjön" trollas fram på scenen av en av de bästa klassiska balettensemblerna, International Festival Ballet. Den grandiosa scenografin av den briljante teaterdesignern Vjatscheslav Okunev, som bl.a. arbetat för Mariinskijteatern i S:t Petersburg och La Scala i Milano, vackra kostymer och balettensemblens gränslösa elegans och bekymmerslösa lätthet ger dessutom en drömsk och sagolik version av en klassisk balett som fortsätter att fascinera även efter mer än 100 år. International Festival Ballet Ensemble dansar vidare Sedan sommaren 2022 har St Petersburg Festival Ballet ett nytt namn. Chockad och påverkad av Rysslands omänskliga angreppskrig mot Ukraina byter den välrenommerade balettensemblen namn till…

ai.en: C.O.F.F.I.N at Debaser Nova, an intense live band from Sydney blending rock and punk.

events.description: Straight out of Sydney, C.O.F.F.I.N have built a reputation as one of Australia’s most intense live bands. Blending rock’n’roll, punk, and boogie with powerful guitars and distinctive lead vocals delivered from behind the drum kit, the band has carved out a unique place on the international rock scene.

ai.en: A Christmas baking workshop at Vaxholm's Bed and Breakfast, learning traditional Swedish Christmas baking.

events.description: During a few hours in the kitchen at Vaxholm’s Bed & Breakfast, participants will learn the secret of baking traditional saffron buns and crispy old-fashioned gingerbread—both essential for a Swedish Christmas. Baking takes place in a group of up to six people. The workshop starts with a shared lunch and concludes with a tasting of the freshly baked saffron buns and gingerbread cookies. Each guest will also receive dough to take home. See you in the kitchen!

ai.en: A Swedish-Asian fusion Christmas buffet at KURA Stockholm, mixing classic Swedish dishes with Asian flavours.

events.description: KURA offers a Swedish-Asian fusion Christmas buffet where classic Swedish Christmas dishes are combined with Asian and Japanese flavours. The Christmas buffet is served in glass-enclosed winter garden and is designed for both private parties and companies looking for a more modern alternative to the traditional Swedish Christmas buffet.

title.en: A Swedish Christmas feast at Matsalen

ai.en: A Swedish Christmas feast at Matsalen in Stockholm Stadshotell, a reinterpretation by former Fäviken head chef Jesper Karlsson.

events.description: Former Fäviken head chef Jesper Karlsson joins Matsalen with his interpretation of Sweden’s traditional Christmas feast. Rather than a buffet, the meal is served to the table in bowls, platters, pots and pans, made for everyone to pass and share. Swedish Christmas classics are joined by an extensive selection of game and flavours from Jämtland.

ai.en: Emmalisa Hallander at Haymarket by Scandic, a Swedish jazz voice presented with Kommon Musik.

events.description: Haymarket and Kommon Musik present Emmalisa Hallander - one of Sweden's most acclaimed jazz voices, known for her captivating stage presence, playful improvisation, and timeless vocal style. Her latest album, Out of Reach, was named one of 2025's best jazz releases and praised for its blend of romantic, classic jazz influences and sharp contemporary songwriting. This is a free event, come early to guarantee a seat.

ai.en: Beast in Black at Fryshuset Arenan in November, celebrating the band's fourth album release.

events.description: Beast In Black is coming to Sweden in November to celebrate the band's fourth album release! Their fourth album is expected to be released in May 2026 and will be celebrated with a grand tour. On November 25, Beast In Black will take the stage at Fryshuset Arena in Stockholm.

ai.en: Sundbybergs Storband at Teater Bristol, a big band jazz orchestra from Sundbyberg.

events.description: Sundbybergs Storband, also known as The Jazz Orchestra of Sundbyberg, has been part of the local music scene for many years. With saxophones, trumpets, trombones and a rhythm section, the orchestra performs well-known jazz classics, expressive solos and new arrangements. The concert combines the warm sound of a big band with swinging rhythms, strong melodies and musical energy.

title.en: The Sheepdogs - Out All Night Tour at Nalen

ai.en: The Sheepdogs' Out All Night tour at Nalen on 25 November, the Canadian rock band.

events.description: Canadian rock band The Sheepdogs return to Sweden for a concert at Nalen in Stockholm on November 25, 2026. Winners of four JUNO Awards, the band is celebrated for their classic rock sound with powerful harmonies, dual guitars, and electrifying energy.

ai.en: Andersson Dance's ORE at Dansens Hus Blackbox, a dance work by Örjan Andersson inspired by Romantic painters such as Friedrich, Turner and Delacroix.

events.description: I ORE tar Örjan Andersson avstamp i landskapet och naturen för att reflektera över människans relation till sin omgivning och de förändringar den genomgår. Med inspiration från romantikens konstnärer -- Caspar David Friedrich, J.M.W. Turner och Eugène Delacroix -- riktas blicken mot både naturens storslagenhet och människans påverkan på den. Genom ljudkonstnären, fältinspelaren och tonsättaren BJ Nilsens inspelningar färdas verket mellan vitt skilda miljöer: från de suggestiva bergslandskapen i Alpe Djouan till de mörka gruvgångarna i Kirkenes bergsmassiv, där damm, sten och industri präglar både landskap och livsvillkor. Här är gruvdriften i full gång med en fullkomligt färglös värld. Dammet ligger tungt och endast olika monokromatiska toner av grått och svart syns över gruvarbetarnas fotavtryck. I scenografen och ljusdesignern Chrisander Bruns gestaltning omformas dessa miljöer till artificiella landskap och rum där nya berättelser kan ta form. Längd: 60 min. OM ÖRJAN ANDERSSON Örjan Andersson är en av Sveriges mest framgångsrika koreografer med över 30 verk bakom sig där han har skapat beställningsverk för flera av de ledande kompanierna i Sverige och Europa och för det egna kompaniet Andersson Dance. De senaste åren har han även arbetat för teaterscenen och gjort succé med sin regi av Werther på Unga Dramaten, Hamlet på Folkteatern i Göteborg, Drottningens juvelsmycke på Helsingborgs Stadsteater och med Orfeus & Eurydike på Unga på Operan.

ai.en: Katarinakörerna's Advent concert on Thursday 26 November at 19:00 at Katarina Kyrka in Stockholm, with 250 choir singers and the large organ. Recommended from age 6.

events.description: Upplev Katarinakörernas berömda adventskonsert med tvåhundrafemtio körsångare, den stora orgeln och andra instrument! Rekommenderas från 6 år. Konsertens längd är cirka 75 minuter. Insläpp från kl 18.20, var god kom i god tid! Rullstolsplatser bokas från 11 nov i Församlingshemmets reception, Högbergsgatan 15A eller på telefon 08-743 68 17 må-to kl 13.00-17.00.

ai.en: A French Christmas menu at Luzette, with the flavours and traditions of a French Christmas.

events.description: Warmly welcome to Luzette this Christmas and experience the flavours and traditions of a French Christmas, with the finest seafood at the heart of the menu. A five-course Christmas menu is offered, featuring classic French flavours. The perfect choice for those looking to experience something different from the traditional Swedish Christmas buffet.

ai.en: Gurriers at Debaser Nova on 26 November, a European indie band with new music.

events.description: Gurriers have quickly become a name to reckon with on the European indie scene, and on November 26 they bring their new album Nobody’s Coming To Save You to Debaser Nova. Since their 2024 debut Come and See, the milestones have kept coming one after another. Now it’s time for the next chapter as the band releases their second record, Nobody’s Coming To Save You.

title.en: Master Boot Record & Fulci + Support: Arottenbit

ai.en: Master Boot Record and Fulci with Arottenbit at Kollektivet Livet, a co-headline heavy music tour.

events.description: Master Boot Record and Fulci join forces for a co-headline tour where two extremes of heavy music collide. Master Boot Record blends heavy riffs with synths and computer-driven aesthetics, while Fulci delivers raw, horror-inspired death metal rooted in classic Italian splatter cinema. Together, they create an intense live experience where futuristic dystopia meets uncompromising heaviness.

title.en: Christmas Table at Karamellan at Drottningholm

ai.en: A Christmas buffet at Karamellan restaurant by Drottningholm Palace, with traditional Swedish dishes.

events.description: Welcome to Karamellan’s Christmas Buffet! Enjoy a traditional Swedish Christmas buffet with a wide selection of hot and cold dishes, homemade desserts, and festive treats. We also offer a generous variety of delicious vegetarian dishes, ensuring there is something for everyone. Gather your family, friends, or colleagues and experience the flavors of Christmas in a warm and welcoming atmosphere. Available from 26 November until 12 December.

title.en: Swedish Christmas Buffet in the Stockholm Archipelago

ai.en: A Swedish Christmas buffet at Sandhamn Seglarhotell in the Stockholm archipelago.

events.description: Discover the flavours of Christmas at Sandhamn Seglarhotell in the Stockholm archipelago. The Swedish Christmas buffet brings together traditional favourites and new flavours: pickled herring, fish and seafood, cold cuts and warm festive dishes. A wide range of plant-based options is also available, from aubergine “herring” to meatballs and Jansson’s gratin. The meal is finished with cheeses, desserts and sweets. Welcome glögg and coffee are included.

ai.en: Capture the City, an urban sketching workshop at the Spårvägsmuseet, drawing rusty boxes, drains and old trams.

events.description: A rusty utility box, a forgotten street drain, an old tram: for urban sketchers, everything deserves to be immortalized. Nina Johansson teaches you the basics of urban sketching, the art of capturing the city one quick sketch at a time. After a short introduction, the participants draw in the museum's exhibitions with the metro as our theme, and finish by adding color to the sketches together. No drawing experience needed. At Spårvägsmuseet, tickets required.

title.en: Talk: New Modes of Transport - E-scooters, Car Sharing and Self-Driving Taxis

ai.en: A talk on new ways of getting around: e-scooters, car sharing and self-driving cars, at the Spårvägsmuseet.

events.description: A row of e-scooters on the pavement, a car-sharing app you forgot you had, and cars that drive themselves. The way we get around the city is constantly changing, but what will become everyday life and what is just a passing trend? This talk looks at how e-scooters, bicycles and car sharing already work with public transport, and what self-driving technology could mean in the long run, with examples from Stockholm and around the world. Talk, 1 hour. At Spårvägsmuseet, tickets required.

title.en: BLANACE and BERNS presents PAUL VAN DYK & ORJAN NILSEN!

ai.en: A PAUL VAN DYK and ORJAN NILSEN night, presented by BLANACE and BERNS at Berns in Stockholm, with Paul van Dyk headlining an evening of trance and electronic music.

events.description: BLANACE and BERNS presents PAUL VAN DYK & ORJAN NILSEN! En av trancevärldens största ikoner kommer till Berns. Vi är stolta över att presentera Paul van Dyk som headline för en exklusiv kväll fylld av euforiska melodier, drivande energi och tidlös elektronisk musik. Med en karriär som format hela den globala trance-scenen har Paul van Dyk gång på gång visat varför han räknas som en av de mest inflytelserika DJ:s och producenterna genom tiderna. Som support välkomnar vi även Ørjan Nilsen, en tung kraft inom den melodiska och energiska trance-scenen, känd för sina kraftfulla produktioner och intensiva liveset. Det här blir en kväll för alla som älskar stora känslor, mäktiga drops och den där unika känslan som bara trance kan skapa. - Åldersgräns: 20 år Insläppstid: 22:30

title.en: French Songs & Gypsy Jazz with Marie-Chantal Long & Swing Club

ai.en: French songs and gypsy jazz with Marie-Chantal Long and Swing Club at Biocafé Tellus.

events.description: French actress and singer Marie-Chantal Long and Swing Club present a full evening of French music—featuring expressive vocals and performance, chansons, Gypsy jazz, and plenty of laughter. Swing Club accompanies Marie-Chantal on French chansons (by the likes of Piaf, Brel, and Barbara) and also performs Gypsy jazz, playing both original compositions and traditional jazz from Django Reinhardt’s repertoire. Food service at the café begins at 6:00 PM.

ai.en: MALL CALL 2026 at Stinsen, a festival of electronic dance music and contemporary club culture.

events.description: MALL CALL is a groundbreaking festival focused on electronic dance music and contemporary club culture. The event takes over the abandoned Stinsen shopping mall in Häggvik, Sollentuna, just north of Stockholm, transforming 30,000 square meters of empty space into a unique experience where music, art, and environment interact. Featured artists include Röyksopp, Overmono, Mount Kimbie, and The Radio Dept.

ai.en: Thrown at Fållan, a Swedish metalcore and hardcore band that is much talked about.

events.description: Swedish band Thrown has rapidly become one of the most talked-about names in modern metalcore and hardcore. With the acclaimed album Excessive Guilt, millions of streams and relentless live performances around the world, the band has built a global following. They now return to Stockholm alongside Counterparts, No Cure and Heavensgate for an intense night of heavy music.

ai.en: Florence Valentin plays Debaser Strand in Stockholm on 27 November. The Swedish indie band is known for its debut single Allt dom bygger upp ska vi meja ner.

events.description: Florence Valentin takes over Debaser Strand on November 27. In the early 2000s, Florence Valentin shook up the Swedish indie scene. With their debut single Allt dom bygger upp ska vi meja ner and albums such as Johnny Drama, Pokerkväll i Vårby Gård and Spring Ricco, they quickly cemented their place in Swedish music history. Now they’re back with new music.

ai.en: DreamHack Stockholm 2026 at Stockholmsmässan, a festival for games, esports and internet culture.

events.description: DreamHack Stockholm is the festival for everyone who loves games, esports, and internet culture. Challenge yourself and others in one of the booths in the record-breaking expo, try out the latest games in the Free-to-play area, meet your favorite streamers, TikTok or YouTube profiles, and experience the hype together with thousands of others.

ai.en: The Skansen Christmas Market, a historic market dating back to 1903, selling crafts, design and sweets.

events.description: Experience a historic Christmas market, dating back to 1903. Buy everything from handicrafts and design to sweets, home-made candles, and secret Christmas gifts.

ai.en: Moon Walker at Debaser Strand, an alternative rock project of the songwriter and producer Harry Spri.

events.description: Moon Walker is one of the most exciting new names in alternative rock. The project of songwriter and producer Harry Springer blends garage rock, funk and psychedelic influences with lyrics balancing social commentary and surreal humor. With over 100 million streams and a rapidly growing fanbase, he is currently touring with the new album “WASTELAND COUNTRY”.

ai.en: Marcus Berggren Finds Home, a Swedish-language stand-up show at Södra Teatern.

events.description: Marcus Berggren returns to the stand-up stage with his new show Marcus Berggren Finds Home. The performance is a wild mix of stand-up, music, poetry, improvisation, and audience interaction. It's about moving home and finding home, with all the comedic detours along the way. Marcus brings a guitar, no inhibitions, and a poem about someone named Göran. Performed in Swedish.

ai.en: Christmas at Skansen, with fires and stories about traditional Christmas in the old houses of the open-air museum.

events.description: A magical Christmas season await you at Skansen! Get cozy by the fire in the old houses and listen to stories about traditions and celebrations past and present. Experience decorated Christmas trees and Swedish Christmas traditions. Meet Santa, make Christmas crafts, enjoy folk music and dance around the tree.

Welcome to Mall Call at Stinsen, Sollentuna, on November 27--28 Club culture has always had a talent for seeing possibilities where others see limitations. Warehouses become dancefloors, forests become raves, abandoned buildings become temporary worlds of their own. Some of the most memorable nights happen in places that were never designed for music in the first place. In November, Mall Call continues that tradition by taking over Stinsen, a vast abandoned shopping mall in Sollentuna, just outside Stockholm. Across 30,000 square metres of empty stores, corridors and forgotten retail spaces, commerce gives way to culture. Electronic artists, visual art, bars and unexpected club spaces move into the building. A former optician might become a wine bar. An empty storefront might turn into an intimate dancefloor. A forgotten corridor might lead somewhere you never expected. The mall becomes more than a venue. It becomes a place to explore, get lost in and experience differently. The mall is closed. The stage is open. events.description: Seven years after their last performance, Alice in Videoland are back. This autumn, the Swedish synth-punk icons embark on their Resurrection Tour. Since their formation, Alice in Videoland have been one of the most distinctive bands on Sweden’s alternative music scene. With their explosive blend of synth, electroclash, punk, and club music, they forged a sound all their own, attracting a devoted following far beyond Sweden’s borders.

events.description: Tyske Ludder bring their uncompromising industrial-electro sound to Debaser. Since the 1990s, the band has shaped the genre with a mix of hard electronic beats and socially critical lyrics. Combining industrial textures with club energy and a strong visual presence, they deliver a powerful and atmospheric live experience.

ai.en: An open dance class for gymnasium students at the Royal Swedish Ballet School at Münchenbryggeriet.

events.description: Do you want to become part of Northern Europe’s leading dance school? At the Royal Swedish Ballet School, we have deep roots in Swedish dance history. Since the 18th century, we have been shaping the dancers of tomorrow together with experienced teachers, renowned dance professionals from around the world, and, not least, all of our students. Take the opportunity to discover a future in dance. Welcome to our open dance class for gymnasium.

title.en: Noah Kahan: The Great Divide World Tour

ai.en: Noah Kahan's The Great Divide World Tour at Avicii Arena in Stockholm. The American folk-pop singer-songwriter is known for Stick Season (2022) and its follow-up The Great Divide (2026).

events.description: Noah Kahan is an American singer-songwriter who rose to prominence with his album *Stick Season* (2022) and its follow-up *The Great Divide* (2026), establishing himself as a leading name in modern folk-pop. His lyrics, which explore both personal and universal emotions, have made him one of the most talked-about artists in the genre. The Stockholm concert is part of his first stadium tour, featuring both new tracks and classics like 'Stick Season' and 'Northern Attitude'.

ai.en: Artemas at Fållan, an English-Cypriot artist blending alternative pop, R&B and soul.

events.description: Artemas is an English-Cypriot artist blending alternative pop, R&B, and soul. His music is characterized by emotional lyrics, catchy melodies, and modern production with influences from 90s pop and funk. He is best known for tracks like 'If U Think I'm Pretty' and 'I Like the Way You Kiss Me'.

ai.en: Thema Balkanica at Pygméteatern, a musical walk through the Western Balkans and Southeast Europe.

events.description: Join us on a musical walk through the Western Balkans and Southeastern Europe. A walk that turns into a sprint when the notes heat up with playful temperament and musical elegance. The trio Thema Balkanica mostly performs sevdalinka, Bosnia and Herzegovina's unique music genre, inscribed on UNESCO's list of intangible cultural heritage of humanity, but there will also be a lot of wonderful, unusual beats from North Macedonia, Southern Serbia, Bulgaria, Romania and Hungary.

events.description: Market for traffic history, i.e. trains, boats, planes, cars. Books, models, postcards, films, etc. Catering upstairs.
